source: La Résistance contre tous les dégâts attributaires de l'ennemi est diminuée de 30 %. Si un membre inflige des Dégâts à un ennemi affecté par des Effets négatifs, les Effets négatifs qui ont lui affectés seront annulés
target: Enemies' Attribute RES is increased by 30%. Dealing damage to enemies with any Negative Status removes all Negative Statuses on Resonators themselves.

source: La Sentinelle de Rinascita. Bien que vénéré comme la Divinité par l'Ordre des Profondeurs, Imperator révèle rarement Sa présence au public.
target: The Sentinel of Rinascita. Though worshipped as the Divinity by the Order of the Deep, Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the public.

source: La Tactique centrale recommandée pour un ensemble.
target: The highly recommended core tactics of a Tactic Set.

source: La actual suma sacerdotisa de Septimont.
target: The current Head Priestess of Septimont.

source: La aparentemente ordinaria habilidad de atributo no parece necesitar demasiada descripción.
target: The seemingly ordinary attribute ability doesn't seem to need too much description.

source: La capacité d'« évolution » permet aux Échos de se renforcer. La production quotidienne de Coupons augmentera si les conditions d'évolution de certains Échos sont remplies.
target: Echoes with this Dream Attribute can grow stronger through Gradation. When certain Echoes meet their Gradation conditions, their Daily Coupon yield increases.

source: La capital de Huanglong. Es el centro político, económico y cultural de la nación.
target: The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.

source: La capitale de Huanglong. Cœur politique, économique et culturel de la nation.
target: The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.

source: La ciudad principal de Septimont, donde se alza la Fortaleza del Grifo y se celebra el Gran Agón.
target: Septimont's central city—home to Gryphon's Fortress and the stage of the Great Agon.

source: La conseillère de la magistrate de Jinzhou. L'actuelle conseillère a enseigné à Jinhsi l'art de gouverner avant qu'elle ne devienne magistrate.
target: The advisor of Jinzhou's Magistrate. The current Counselor taught Jinhsi the way of governing before she became the Magistrate.

source: La consejera de la magistrada de Jinzhou. La actual consejera enseñó a Jinhsi cómo gobernar antes de que se convirtiera en magistrada.
target: The advisor of Jinzhou's Magistrate. The current Counselor taught Jinhsi the way of governing before she became the Magistrate.

source: La curación de la burbuja curativa aumenta en un 150%.
La duración de la inmovilización de Hyvatia se reduce en un 25%, pero su DEF se reduce en un 5% por cada vez que recibe una Ruptura de Tonalidad, hasta un máximo del 60%.
target: Hyvatia's Immobilization duration is reduced by 25%. For each Tune Break it takes, its DEF is reduced by 5%, up to 60%.

source: La duración de la inmovilización de Hyvatia se reduce en un 25%, pero su DEF se reduce en un 7% por cada vez que recibe una Ruptura de Tonalidad, hasta un máximo del 70%.
target: Hyvatia's Immobilization duration is reduced by 25%. For each Tune Break it takes, its ATK is reduced by 7%, up to 70%.

source: La durée de paralysie de Hyvatia est réduite de 25 %. Chaque fois qu'elle subit des dégâts d'Interruption de tonalité, sa DEF diminue de 5 %, elle peut être réduite jusqu'à 60 %.
target: Hyvatia's Immobilization duration is reduced by 25%. For each Tune Break it takes, its DEF is reduced by 5%, up to 60%.

source: La durée de paralysie de Hyvatia est réduite de 25 %. Chaque fois qu'elle subit des dégâts d'Interruption de tonalité, sa DEF diminue de 7 %, elle peut être réduite jusqu'à 70 %.
target: Hyvatia's Immobilization duration is reduced by 25%. For each Tune Break it takes, its ATK is reduced by 7%, up to 70%.

source: La eficiencia del rango sinfónico se reduce un 25%.
target: Symphony Rank efficiency is reduced by 25%.

source: La eficiencia del rango sinfónico se reduce un 50%.
target: Symphony Rank efficiency is reduced by 50%.

source:
La famille la plus ancienne et énigmatique de Ragunna, les Fisalia sont réputés pour leur expertise en potions et en fabrication de poisons.
Leur dévotion inébranlable envers la Sentinelle est bien connue parmi les citoyens.
target: The most enduring and enigmatic family in Ragunna, the Fisalias are renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison crafting. Their unwavering devotion to the Sentinel is well-known among the citizens.

source: La forêt où vivent les Solisiens. Baignés par la lumière du noyau du réacteur, les bois sont épargnés par les tempêtes de néant.
target: The forest where the Soliskin dwell. Bathed in the light of the Reactor Drive, the woods remain untouched by the ravages of Void Storms.

source: La fuerza local de seguridad de la Comisión de Justicia. Mantiene el orden civil y controla asuntos de seguridad pública, mientras opera a través de estaciones de patrulla. Sus oficiales son conocidos como «patrulleros».
target: The local law enforcement arm of the Justice Commission. Operating through Patrol Stations, it maintains civil order and handles public security matters. Its officers are known as "Patrollers."

source:
La limite maximale de Flux stellaire est de {0} points.
Gagne des points de Flux stellaire au fil du temps.
target:
Starflux is capped at {0} points.
Starflux recovers naturally over time.

source:
La limite maximale de Photos est de {16}.
{17} Traces accumulées seront converties en 1 Photo.
target:
Lucilla can hold up to {16} Photos.
Every {17} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of Trace restored generates 1 Photo.

source:
La limite maximale est de {0} points.
Obtient l'Intention de l'épée du cœur lorsque l'Attaque normale - Illumination éphémère ou la Contre-attaque d'esquive - Illumination éphémère inflige des dégâts.
target:
Qingxiao can hold up to {0} points.
Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence or Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence grants Heart Sword Intent.

source:
La limite maximale est de {0} points.
Obtient les points de Cadence du sabre lorsque la Posture dégainée inflige des dégâts.
Il est impossible d'obtenir la « Cadence du sabre pendant l'Illumination éphémère.
target:
Qingxiao can hold up to {0} points.
Dealing damage with Drawn Stance skills grants Sword Cadence.
Sword Cadence cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

source:
La limite maximale est de {0} points.
Obtient les points de Cœur de Qin lorsque la Posture rengainée inflige des dégâts.
Il est impossible d'obtenir le « Cœur de Qin pendant l'Illumination éphémère.
target:
Qingxiao can hold up to {0} points.
Dealing damage with Sheathed Stance skills grants Qin Heart.
Qin Heart cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

source: La nación a la que pertenece la ciudad de Honami. A pesar de los frecuentes fenómenos de Erosionda, mantiene una urbanización próspera con una red ferroviaria bien desarrollada.
target: The nation encompassing Honami City. Despite the frequent Waveworn Phenomena, it maintains a prosperous, highly urbanized society, marked by its sprawling railroad network.

source: La nation à laquelle Honami appartient. Malgré les fréquents phénomènes d'érosion dont elle est victime, elle dispose de villes prospères et d'un réseau ferroviaire très développé.
target: The nation encompassing Honami City. Despite the frequent Waveworn Phenomena, it maintains a prosperous, highly urbanized society, marked by its sprawling railroad network.

source: La obtención de Cupones diarios +100% (5% de prob.) al evolucionar.
target: When an Echo undergoes Gradation, there is a 5% chance to increase its Daily Coupon yield by 100%.

source: La obtención de Cupones diarios del Eco en este Bloque aumenta en 2 de forma temporal. Esta bonificación se elimina al abandonar el Bloque.
target: The Daily Coupon yield of Echoes on these Dream Blocks temporarily increases by 2. The bonus is removed once it leaves these Dream Blocks.

source: La portée et le multiplicateur de Dégâts de base sont renforcés considérablement.
target: Greatly increase range and DMG Multiplier.

source: La primera Integración del día requiere un Eco menos.
target: The first Echo that initiate Integration require 1 less Echo.

source: La probabilidad de activar un golpe crítico al infligir daño.
target: The chance of triggering a Critical Hit when dealing damage.

source: La production quotidienne de Coupons du parc est augmentée temporairement de 2 quand l'Écho est sur ce bloc. L'effet sera annulé dès qu'il quitte ce bloc.
target: The Daily Coupon yield of Echoes on these Dream Blocks temporarily increases by 2. The bonus is removed once it leaves these Dream Blocks.

source: La quantité de Coupons du parc quotidien obtenus via d'autres moyens que les Échos est augmentée de 10 %.
target: Dreamland Coupon gained through sources other than Echo Daily Coupon yield is increased by 10%.

source: La realidad, en contraposición a “este lado del sueño”.
target: The reality, as opposed to "this side of the dream."

source: La resistencia máxima del personaje se reduce un 10%.
target: Resonator's Max STA is reduced by 10%.

source: La resistencia máxima del personaje se reduce un 15%.
target: Resonator's Max STA is reduced by 15%.

source: La resistencia máxima del personaje se reduce un 20%.
target: Resonators' max STA is reduced by 20%.

source: La resistencia máxima del personaje se reduce un 40%.
target: Resonators' max STA is reduced by 60%.

source: La resistencia máximo del personaje se reduce en un 20%.
target: Resonators' max STA is reduced by 20%.

source: La resistencia máximo del personaje se reduce en un 40%.
target: Resonators' max STA is reduced by 40%.

source: La réalité, par opposition à « ce côté du rêve ».
target: The reality, as opposed to "this side of the dream."

source: La résistance aux dégâts des ennemis est augmentée de 10 %.
target: Enemy All-Attribute RES is increased by 10%.

source: La résistance aux dégâts des ennemis est augmentée de 15 %.
target: Enemy All-Attribute RES is increased by 15%.

source: La tienda de KU-Money aparece tras ciertas oleadas, donde puedes consumir Monedas Sim para comprar tácticas y objetos.
target: KU-Money's Shop appears after certain waves, where you can consume Sim Credits to purchase Tactics and items.

source: La unidad de seguridad local del Buró de Seguridad Pública que gestiona operaciones de seguridad de rutina y mantiene el orden público.
target: The local enforcement unit of the Public Security Bureau that handles routine security operations and maintains public order.

source: La ville centrale de Septimont, où se trouvent la Forteresse du Griffon et l'amphithéâtre du Grand agôn.
target: Septimont's central city—home to Gryphon's Fortress and the stage of the Great Agon.

source: Lance la Compétence résonatrice - Note tranchante : Jugement pour obtenir {0} point(s) de Cœur de Qin et annuler le bonus de Carillon résonnant.
target: Casting Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement grants {0} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Qin Heart and removes Resonant Chime.

source: Lancez l'Attaque lourde « Détoner » pour le faire exploser et infliger des Dégâts Glacio.
target: Can be detonated by Heavy Attack Detonate, dealing Glacio DMG.

source: Lancez la Libération résonatrice « Réignition » pour entrer en « Mode infernal ».
target: Casting Resonance Liberation Rekindle sends Zani into Infernal Mode.

source: Lanza aleatoriamente una estrella a los enemigos, infligiendo Daño Fusión.
target: Randomly launches a star to fall upon enemies, dealing Fusion DMG.

source: Lanza aleatoriamente una trampa que detona después de un tiempo o al tocar a un enemigo, infligiendo Daño Fusión.
target: Randomly flips a trap that detonates after a while or upon touching an enemy, dealing AoE Fusion DMG.

source: Lanza fuego continuamente hacia adelante, infligiendo Daño Destrucción. No puede beneficiarse de bonificaciones de velocidad de ataque.
target: Continuously sprays fire forward, dealing Havoc DMG. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.

source: Lança Habilidade de Ressonância: Som Flutuante · Castigo, pode obter {0} pontos de Coração de Qin e remover Som Dourado Retumbante.
target: Casting Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement grants {0} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Qin Heart and removes Resonant Chime.

source: Lança aleatoriamente uma estrela que cai sobre os inimigos, causando Dano Térmico.
target: Randomly launches a star to fall upon enemies, dealing Fusion DMG.

source: Lançar ATQ Pesado inflige 2 acúmulos de Esfoladura Criogênica ao Ressonante. Lançar a Liberação de Ressonância remove todos os acúmulos de Esfoladura Criogênica.
target: Casting Heavy Attack inflicts 2 stacks of Glacio Chafe on the Resonator. Casting Resonance Liberation removes all stacks of Glacio Chafe.

source: Lançar Habilidade de Ressonância consumirá 15% do HP atual do Ressonante e reduzirá a recarga da Habilidade de Ressonância em 50%. Este efeito só pode ser ativado uma vez a cada 6s para cada Ressonante.
target: Casting Resonance Skill consumes 15% of the Resonator's current HP and reduces Resonance Skill cooldown by 50%. This effect can be triggered once every 6s for each Resonator.

source: Lançar Habilidade de Ressonância inflige 2 acúmulos de Esfoladura Criogênica ao Ressonante. Lançar a Liberação de Ressonância remove todos os acúmulos de Esfoladura Criogênica.
target: Casting Resonance Skill inflicts 2 stacks of Glacio Chafe on the Resonator. Casting Resonance Liberation removes all stacks of Glacio Chafe.

source: Lançar a Liberação de Ressonância Reacender envia Zani para o Modo Infernal.
target: Casting Resonance Liberation Rekindle sends Zani into Infernal Mode.

source: Lançar o ATQ Pesado Ladainha de Absolvição ou a Habilidade de Ressonância Confissão Absoluta restaura 60 de Voz Divina.
target: Casting Heavy Attack Absolution Litany or Resonance Skill Utter Confession restores 60 Divine Voice.

source: Las Disonancias Tácitas surgen de las frecuencias de pesadillas y emociones negativas. Se pueden encontrar a menudo en Somnolencia.
target: The Tacet Discords emerge from the frequencies of nightmares and negative emotions. They can often be found in Somnoire.

source: Las acciones de Eliminación automática incluyen Intercambiar, Integrar, Devorar y Autoeliminar. Eliminar un Eco manualmente no cuenta como Eliminación automática.
target: Echoes are seen as Removed when they are Exchanged, Integrated, Devoured, or Removed by themselves. Dismissing an Echo does not count as Removal.

source: Las estancias de las sacerdotisas, así como el lugar donde se observan y documentan el destino y las profecías. Comúnmente conocido como «el Templo».
target: The living quarters of Priestesses, where fate is observed and prophecies are documented. Commonly referred to as the "Temple."

source: Las tácticas principales altamente recomendadas de un conjunto de tácticas.
target: The highly recommended core tactics of a Tactic Set.

source: Las áreas hexagonales que comparten un borde se consideran adyacentes entre sí.
target: Hexagonal areas that share a border are considered adjacent to each other.

source: Le Bombardement se déclenche désormais 4 fois en 5 secondes.
target: Bombardment interval is reduced to 4s, but happens only 5 times each round.

source: Le Bombardement se déclenche désormais 5 fois en 5 secondes.
target: Bombardment interval is reduced to 5s, but happens only 5 times each round.

source: Le Bombardement se déclenche désormais 8 fois en 10 secondes.
target: Bombardment becomes 8 times each round, but the interval is extended to 10s.

source: Le Bombardement se déclenche désormais 8 fois en 12 secondes.
target: Bombardment becomes 8 times each round, but the interval is extended to 12s.

source: Le Bonus de Dégâts de tous les ennemis est augmenté de 5 % et la DEF est diminuée de 5 % toutes les 5 secondes. L'effet peut être cumulé 20 fois.
target: All enemies gain 5% DMG Bonus and have their DEF reduced by 5% every 5s, stacking up to 20 times.

source: Le Bonus de rupture augmente les Dégâts de rupture et les Dégâts infligés aux cibles perturbées.
target: Tune Break Boost increases Tune Break DMG and the DMG dealt to Interfered targets

source: Le Canon planeur vise le personnage toutes les 10 secondes et il lance des attaques après une certaine durée.
target: Every 10s, Hyvatia's Hover Cannons lock onto the Resonator and launch attacks on their last location after a while.

source: Le Dépôt d'Ichor explose automatiquement après {0} secondes, il inflige des Dégâts Spectro qui sont des dégâts d'Attaque normale.
target: Ichor Deposit detonates automatically after {0}s, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

source:
Le Lançours va diminuer le dégât subi par Feilian Beringal de 50 %.
Quand un ennemi est vaincu, la DEF de tous les membres de l'équipe est augmentée de 10 %. L'effet peut être cumulé.
target:
Spearback provides the following effect: Feilian Beringal takes 50% less DMG.
Defeating an enemy increases DEF of Resonators in the team by 10%. This effect is stackable.

source: Le Phénomène d'érosion de Lahai-Roi, qui perturbe toutes les fréquences à proximité. Cela se produit selon un cycle plus ou moins régulier.
target: The regional Waveworn Phenomenon of Lahai-Roi that disrupts the frequencies of anything around it. It happens in a somewhat cyclical pattern.

source: Le Sénat est l'organe dirigeant de Septimont. Il est chargé de conseiller l'Éphore et exerce son autorité sur les affaires administratives clés. Il détient également le pouvoir de nommer et de révoquer les fonctionnaires.
target: The governing body of Septimont, tasked with advising the Ephor and wielding authority in key administrative matters. It also exercises power over the appointment and dismissal of public officials.

source: Le Taux de vibration de Nova jumelle augmente de 100 % et les deux seront paralysées simultanément.
target: The Twins' Vibration Strength is increased by 100%. Immobilizing one also immobilizes the other.

source: Le Taux de vibration de l'Explorateur sans nom augmente de 30 % et sa vitesse de déplacement augmente lorsque le personnage le touche avec la Compétence d'Intro pendant 10 secondes.
target: Nameless Explorer's Vibration Strength is increased by 30%. Casting Intro Skill increases the Resonator's Movement Speed for 10s.

source: Le Taux de vibration de l'Explorateur sans nom augmente de 50 % et sa vitesse de déplacement augmente lorsque le personnage le touche avec la Compétence d'Intro pendant 10 secondes.
target: Nameless Explorer's Vibration Strength is increased by 50%. Casting Intro Skill increases the Resonator's Movement Speed for 10s.

source: Le Taux de vibration de l'ennemi se régénère progressivement. Lorsqu'il subit une attaque d'Interruption de tonalité, le personnage réduit le Taux de vibration de cet ennemi avec une efficacité augmentée de 50 % pendant 2 secondes.
target: Enemies continuously recover their Vibration Strength. Upon being inflicted with Tune Break, their Vibration Strength Reduction Rate is increased by 50% for 2s.

source: Le Taux de vibration maximum de l'ennemi est augmenté de 100 %.
target: Enemy Max Vibration Strength is increased by 100%.

source: Le Taux de vibration maximum de l'ennemi est augmenté de 100 %. L'Attaque coopérative du personnage qui touche l'ennemi va diminuer 7 % son Taux de vibration de manière supplémentaire.
target: Enemies' Max Vibration Strength is increased by 100%. Each time hitting an enemy with Coordinated Attack additionally reduces their Vibration Strength by 7%.

source: Le Taux de vibration maximum de l'ennemi est augmenté de 100 %. La contre-attaque d'esquive du personnage qui touche l'ennemi va diminuer 10 % son Taux de vibration de manière supplémentaire.
target: Enemies' Max Vibration Strength is increased by 100%. Each time hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter additionally reduces their Vibration Strength by 10%.

source: Le Taux de vibration maximum de l'ennemi est augmenté de 15 %.
target: Enemy Max Vibration Strength is increased by 15%.

source: Le Taux de vibration maximum de l'ennemi est augmenté de 30 %.
target: Enemy Max Vibration Strength is increased by 30%.

source: Le Taux de vibration maximum de l'ennemi est augmenté de 50 %.
target: Enemy Max Vibration Strength is increased by 50%.

source: Le Temps de recharge de Compétence résonatrice est diminué de 50 %. Consommer 15 % des PV actuels pour lancer la Compétence résonatrice. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois par un personnage toutes les 6 secondes.
target: Casting Resonance Skill consumes 15% of the Resonator's current HP and reduces Resonance Skill cooldown by 50%. This effect can be triggered once every 6s for each Resonator.

source: Le Temps de recharge de Compétence résonatrice est prolongé de 50 %.
target: Resonance Skill cooldown is increased by 50%.

source: Le Temps de recharge de Libération résonatrice est prolongé de 100 %.
target: Resonance Liberation cooldown is increased by 100%.

source: Le Temps de recharge de Libération résonatrice est prolongé de 300 %. Après qu'un ennemi est vaincu par le membre actif, son Temps de recharge de Libération résonatrice est réinitialisé immédiatement.
target: Resonance Liberation cooldown is increased by 300%. When the active Resonator defeats an enemy, their Resonance Liberation cooldown is immediately reset.

source: Le Temps de recharge de Libération résonatrice est prolongé de 300 %. Chaque fois qu'un membre inflige des dégâts, le Temps de recharge sera diminué de 1 seconde. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois toutes les 0,2 secondes.
target: Resonance Liberation cooldown is increased by 300%. Dealing damage reduces Resonance Liberation cooldown for the Resonator by 1s, triggered once per 0.2s.

source: Le bras local d'application de la loi du Département de Justice. Opérant à travers des Stations de Patrouille, il maintient l'ordre civil et gère les questions de sécurité publique. Ses officiers sont connus sous le nom de « Patrouilleurs ».
target: The local law enforcement arm of the Justice Commission. Operating through Patrol Stations, it maintains civil order and handles public security matters. Its officers are known as "Patrollers."

source: Le dessert préféré de Danjin. Il est considéré comme un symbole de chance et de bénédiction en raison de son association avec les dragons.
target: Danjin's favorite dessert. It is considered a symbol of good luck and blessings because of its association with loong.

source: Le dirigeant de Septimont. Les Éphores détiennent un pouvoir absolu, car seuls les puissants sont jugés dignes de gouverner.
target: The ruler of Septimont. Ephors wield absolute power, as only the strong are deemed worthy to lead.

source: Le dirigeant de l'Association d'Entraide pour la Résurrection de l'Âme, autrefois disciple des parents de Yinlin.
target: The leader of the Séance Society, formerly a disciple under Yinlin's parents.

source: Le mentor de Changli, un ermite vénéré à Huanglong connu pour sa connaissance de l'art de gouverner et de la diplomatie. Il a beaucoup voyagé pour partager sa sagesse et son savoir.
target: Changli's mentor, a revered hermit in Huanglong known for his knowledge of statecraft and diplomacy. He traveled widely to share his wisdom and knowledge.

source: Le multiplicateur des dégâts lors d'un Coup Critique a eu lieu.
target: The DMG Multiplier when triggering a Critical Hit.

source: Le niveau de relique augmente automatiquement dès que certaines conditions sont remplies et ses effets seront améliorés. Le niveau de relique initial est 1.
target: Relic items will automatically level up and grow more powerful after meeting certain conditions. Relic Level starts at 1 by default.

source: Le plus grand et le plus influent événement de gladiateurs à Septimont, ainsi qu'un pilier économique de la ville.
target: The largest and most influential Gladiator event in Septimont, as well as a key economic pillar of the city.

source: Le port qui relie Septimont au monde extérieur. Les navires, chargés de marchandises et de prises récentes, arrivent chaque heure, tandis que les gladiateurs et voyageurs font escale ici en arrivant à Septimont.
target: The port that connects Septimont to the outside world. Vessels laden with goods and fresh catch arrive by the hour, while visiting Gladiators and travelers make landfall here upon reaching Septimont.

source: Le principal terrain de chasse des niveaux moyens et supérieurs des plateaux du Sanguis, où des générations de Septimontais ont affronté la Marée Noire et ses créatures.
target: The main hunting ground on the mid to upper levels of the Sanguis Plateaus, where generations of Septimontians battled the Dark Tide and its creations.

source: Le retrait d'Écho consiste à : Échanger, Intégrer ou Dévorer un Écho sur le terrain (Si vous extrayez un Écho déjà sur le terrain, cette action ne sera pas considérée comme « retrait »)
target: Echoes are seen as Removed when they are Exchanged, Integrated, Devoured, or Removed by themselves. Dismissing an Echo does not count as Removal.

source: Le temps de recharge du Changement du membre devient 3 secondes. (Cela n'affecte pas le lancement de la Compétence d'Intro)
target: Resonator switch Cooldown is increased to 3s (Intro Skill not affected).

source: Le temps de recharge du Changement du membre devient 3 secondes. (Cela n'affecte pas le lancement de la Compétence d'Intro)
target: Resonator switch cooldown is increased to 3s (Intro Skill not affected).

source: Le temps de recharge du Changement du membre devient 5 secondes. (Cela n'affecte pas le lancement de la Compétence d'Intro)
target: Resonator switch Cooldown is increased to 5s (Intro Skill not affected).

source: Le temps de recharge du Changement du membre devient 5 secondes. (Cela n'affecte pas le lancement de la Compétence d'Intro)
target: Resonator switch cooldown is increased to 5s (Intro Skill not affected).

source: Le terme général référant aux niveaux inférieurs des plateaux de Sanguis corrompus par la Marée noire. La zone regorge d'environnements hostiles et ne présente que peu de signes de présence humaine.
target: The term referring to the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus corrupted by the Dark Tide. This desolate region is marked by hostile conditions and is largely devoid of human activity.

source: Le type « Hache hache » : Hache hache / Hache hache : Tête / Hache hache : Gauche / Hache hache : Droit / Hache hache - Né du rêve.
target: Chop Chop Echoes include: Chop Chop, Chop Chop: Head, Chop Chop: Leftless, Chop Chop: Rightless, Dreamborne: Chop Chop.

source: Le type « Prisme » : Champirose (Petit) / Champirose / Champirose (Petit) - Né du rêve / Champirose - Né du rêve
target: Roseshroom Echoes include: Baby Roseshroom, Roseshroom, Dreamborne: Baby Roseshroom, Dreamborne: Roseshroom.

source: Le type « Prisme » : Prisme Glacio / Prisme Fusion / Prisme Havoc / Prisme Spectro
target: Prism Echoes include: Glacio Prism, Fusion Prism, Havoc Prism, Spectro Prism.

target: Tune Break Boost increases Tune Break DMG and the DMG dealt to Interfered targets

source: O Cupom da Terra dos Sonhos obtido através de fontes que não sejam a colheita de Cupom Diário dos ecos recebe +10%.
target: Dreamland Coupon gained through sources other than Echo Daily Coupon yield is increased by 10%.

target: Negative Status DMG taken by both Resonators and enemies is Amplified by 50%.

source: O Explorador Anônimo é muito fortalecido, e seu ATQ é consideravelmente aumentado.
target: Nameless Explorer is greatly empowered, and their ATK is greatly increased.

source: O Fenômeno de Erisionda regional de Lahai-Roi que interrompe as frequências de tudo ao seu redor. Acontece em um padrão um tanto cíclico.
target: The regional Waveworn Phenomenon of Lahai-Roi that disrupts the frequencies of anything around it. It happens in a somewhat cyclical pattern.

source: O HP Máx. do Ressonante é reduzido para 10%. Enquanto o Ranque Sinfônico estiver em S ou superior, o HP do Ressonante não cairá abaixo de 1%.

target: Resonator max HP is reduced to 80%. While Symphony Rank is at or above S, Resonator HP will not drop below 1%.

target: Enemy max HP is increased by 100%. Counterattacks, Dodge Counters, and Intro Skills deal additional damage to enemies.

source: O HP Máx. do inimigo aumenta em 20%. Contra-ataques, Contra-ataques Evasivos e Habilidades Intros causam dano adicional aos inimigos.

target: Enemy max HP is increased by 50%.

target: Resonator's HP cannot exceed 25% of the Max HP. While Symphony Rank is at or above SS, Resonator's HP will not drop below 1%.

source: O Multiplicador de Dano ao causar um Acerto Crítico.
target: The DMG Multiplier when triggering a Critical Hit.
The Other Side of the Dream

target: The receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.

source: O Ressonante tem sua Regen. de Energia reduzida em 10%.
target: Resonator's Energy Regen is reduced by 10%.

source: O Ressonante tem sua Regen. de Energia reduzida em 20%.
target: Resonator's Energy Regen is reduced by 20%.

source: O Sentinela de Rinascita. Embora adorado como a Divindade pela Ordem das Profundezas, Imperator raramente revela Sua presença ao público.
target: The Sentinel of Rinascita. Though worshipped as the Divinity by the Order of the Deep, Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the public.

source: O VIG Máx. do Ressonante é reduzido em 10%.
target: Resonator's Max STA is reduced by 10%.

target: Resonators' max STA is reduced by 60%.

source: O braço local de aplicação da lei da Comissão de Justiça. Operando através de Estações de Patrulha, mantém a ordem civil e trata de questões de segurança pública. Seus oficiais são conhecidos como "Patrulhas".
target: The local law enforcement arm of the Justice Commission. Operating through Patrol Stations, it maintains civil order and handles public security matters. Its officers are known as "Patrollers."

source: O conselheiro da Magistrada de Jinzhou. O atual conselheiro ensinou a Jinhsi o caminho de governar antes de ela se tornar a Magistrada.
target: The advisor of Jinzhou's Magistrate. The current Counselor taught Jinhsi the way of governing before she became the Magistrate.

source: O continente de Septimont e o Planalto Sangrento são separados por uma via marítima estreita e longa.
target: The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.

source: O dano causado a alvos infligidos com Desconstrução ignora 18% da DEF.
target: Dealing DMG to targets inflicted with Deconstruction ignores 18% of their DEF.

source: O eco é colocado em um local fixo no campo.
target: The Echo is placed in a fixed place on the field.

source: O esporte característico de Septimont, onde Ecos lutam ao lado dos gladiadores. A vitória na arena depende da sua cooperação.
target: Septimont's signature sport, where Echoes battle beside Gladiators. Victory in the arena hinges on their cooperation.

source: O governante lendário de Septimont. A lenda tem raízes em uma profecia antiga de que apenas aquele que se tornar o Herói dos Heróis pode salvar Septimont da ruína.
target: The legendary ruler of Septimont. The legend traces its roots to an ancient prophecy that only the one who becomes the Hero of Heroes can save Septimont from falling into ruin.

source: O inimigo tem a DEF aumentada em 10%.
O inimigo tem a DEF aumentada em 20%.

source: O inimigo tem sua RES aumentada em 10%.

source: O inimigo tem sua RES aumentada em 15%.
target: Enemy All-Attribute RES is increased by 15%.

source: O instituto de pesquisa estatal de Huanglong, com organizações filiais estabelecidas em cada cidade.
target: The state-run research institute of Huanglong, with branch organizations established in each city.

target: Bombardment interval is reduced to 4s, but happens only 5 times each round.

source: O intervalo do Bombardeio é reduzido para 5s, mas ocorre apenas 5 vezes.
target: Bombardment interval is reduced to 5s, but happens only 5 times each round.

source: O maior e mais influente evento de gladiadores em Septimont, além de ser um pilar econômico essencial da cidade.
target: The largest and most influential Gladiator event in Septimont, as well as a key economic pillar of the city.

source: O mentor de Changli, um eremita reverenciado em Huanglong famoso por seu conhecimento da arte de governar e da diplomacia. Ele viajou por muitos lugares para compartilhar sua sabedoria e conhecimento.
target: Changli's mentor, a revered hermit in Huanglong known for his knowledge of statecraft and diplomacy. He traveled widely to share his wisdom and knowledge.

source: O máx. de HP do inimigo é aumentado em 15%.
target: Enemy Max HP is increased by 15%.

source: O máx. de HP do inimigo é aumentado em 30%.
target: Enemy Max HP is increased by 30%.

target: Enemy Max HP is increased by 20%. Dodge Counter additionally deal DMG equal to 3% of the enemies' Max HP.

target: Resonators' max STA is reduced by 20%.

source: O máx. de VIG dos Ressonantes é reduzido em 40%.
target: Resonators' max STA is reduced by 40%.

source: O nome antigo de "Sussurrolândia". Devastada há dezesseis anos pela explosão da Maré Sombria, agora é uma cidade de Gladiadores perdida nas Terras Desoladas.
target: The past name of "Murmurstown." Devastated sixteen years ago by the outbreak of the Dark Tide, it is now a lost Gladiator town in the Wastelands.

source: O poder do Lamento causa ondas destrutivas por Solaris. Manifestações como os "Campos de Dissonância", "Surtos de Dissonância Transgressora" e a enigmática "Tacetita" são parte do que é coletivamente conhecido como "Fenômenos de Erosionda".
target: The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."

source: O porto que liga Septimont ao mundo exterior. Embarcações repletas de mercadorias e pescado fresco chegam a toda hora, enquanto gladiadores visitantes e viajantes desembarcam aqui ao chegarem a Septimont.
target: The port that connects Septimont to the outside world. Vessels laden with goods and fresh catch arrive by the hour, while visiting Gladiators and travelers make landfall here upon reaching Septimont.

source: O primeiro eco que iniciar Integração requer 1 eco a menos.
target: The first Echo that initiate Integration require 1 less Echo.

source: O principal campo de caça nos níveis médios e superiores do Planalto Sangrento, onde gerações de septimontanos lutaram contra a Maré Sombria e suas criações.
target: The main hunting ground on the mid to upper levels of the Sanguis Plateaus, where generations of Septimontians battled the Dark Tide and its creations.

source: O termo que se refere aos níveis inferiores do Planalto Sangrento corrompidos pela Maré Sombria. Esta região desolada é marcada por condições hostis e é amplamente desprovida de atividade humana.
target: The term referring to the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus corrupted by the Dark Tide. This desolate region is marked by hostile conditions and is largely devoid of human activity.

source: O órgão governante de Septimont, encarregado de aconselhar o éforo e exercer autoridade em questões administrativas importantes. Também exerce poder sobre a nomeação e demissão de funcionários públicos.
target: The governing body of Septimont, tasked with advising the Ephor and wielding authority in key administrative matters. It also exercises power over the appointment and dismissal of public officials.

source:
Objeto usado por los royas para observar el Motor Reactor, únicamente a disposición de los Seis Heliódicos.
Durante la Ceremonia del Nuevo Sol, proporciona al Helios datos de observación directa del Motor Reactor.
target:
An artifact used exclusively by the Heliodic Six to observe the Reactor Drive.
During the New Solar Ceremony, it provides Helios with raw observational data on the Reactor Drive.

source: Obtenir 5 coupons à chaque fois qu'une dévoration a lieu.
target: Gain 5 Dreamland Coupons each time Devouring occurs.

source:
Obtenir {0} Particule du néant chaque seconde.
Le Bascule d'entropie : Forme déconstruite est annulé lorsque le personnage obtient ce bonus.
target:
Grants {0} point of Void Particle per second.
Obtaining this effect removes the Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect.

source: Obtenu d'un Spectre de Nimbus vaincu, ou d'un Tacet Discord vaincu par l'Écho d'Hologramme : Coffre trompeur.
target: Nimbus Wraith and Tacet Discords defeated by Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic may drop this item.

source: Ocorreu um erro. Entre em contato com o SAC.
target: The seemingly ordinary attribute ability doesn't seem to need too much description.

target: the ability to align electric charges.

source: Ombres des émotions étudiantes dans le côté obscur, reflétant ce qui se cache au fond de leur cœur.
target: Shadows of students' emotions in the Dark Side, which mirror the hidden feelings within the students' hearts.

source: Opfergabe: Entfernt sich nach 2 Tagen als Opfergabeobjekt. Beim Opfern erhöht sich der Traumland-Gutschein-Ertrag aller Echos um 30 % des Ertrags von diesem Echo; Dieses Echo kann nicht über die Echo-Rekrutierung erhalten werden.
target: Exchange: After 2 days, Removes itself as an Item of Exchange. When Exchanging, adjacent Echoes' Daily Coupon yield increases by 30% of this Echo's Daily Coupon yield. This Echo cannot be obtained through Echo Recruitment.

source: Os Gêmeos têm sua Força de Vibração aumentada em 100%. Imobilizar um também imobiliza o outro.
target: The Twins' Vibration Strength is increased by 100%. Immobilizing one also immobilizes the other.

source: Os Patrulheiros da Meia-noite têm três divisões: Batedores (reconhecimento), Vanguarda (operações ofensivas) e Retaguarda (operações defensivas), todas sob o comando do General Jiyan.
target: The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations), all under the command of General Jiyan.

source: Os Ressonantes atingidos por uma Bolha Explosiva têm o ATQ reduzido em 80% por 15s.
target: Resonators hit by a Burst Bubble have their ATK reduced by 80% for 15s.

source: Os Ressonantes na equipe sofrem 100% mais dano. Enquanto o Ranque Sinfônico for SS ou acima, os HP dos Ressonantes não ficarão abaixo de 1%.
target: Resonators in the team take 100% more DMG. While Symphony Rank is at or above SS, Resonators' HP will not drop below 1%.

source: Os Ressonantes ou inimigos atingidos por uma Bolha Curativa têm a DEF aumentada em 15% por 15s, acumulando até 5 vezes.
target: Resonators or enemies hit by a Healing Bubble have their DEF increased by 15% for 15s, stacking up to 5 times.

source: Os Ressonantes ou inimigos atingidos por uma Bolha Curativa têm o ATQ aumentado em 15% por 15s, acumulando até 5 vezes.
target: Resonators or enemies hit by a Healing Bubble have their ATK increased by 15% for 15s, stacking up to 5 times.

source: Os Ressonantes recebem 20% a menos de Cura.
Os Ressonantes sofrem 30% mais dano. Contra-ATQ Evasivo causa dano adicional equivalente a 3% do máx. de HP ao inimigo.
target: Resonators take 30% more DMG. Dodge Counter additionally deals DMG equal to 3% of their Max HP to the enemy.

source: Os Ressonantes são afligidos com 1 acúmulo de Estouro Térmico a cada 1s.
target: Resonators are inflicted with 1 stack of Fusion Burst every 2s.

source: Os aposentos das Videntes, onde o destino é observado e as profecias são documentadas. Comumente conhecido como o "Templo".
target: The living quarters of Priestesses, where fate is observed and prophecies are documented. Commonly referred to as the "Temple."

source: Os ataques corpo a corpo dos Gêmeos causam 15% a mais de Dano e reduzem a Velocidade de Movimento do alvo.
target: The Twins' melee attacks deal 15% more DMG and reduce the target's Movement Speed.

source: Os ataques de Hyvatia drenam ENE. Os Ressonantes sofrem 20% a mais de Dano quando sua ENE cai abaixo de 20%. Uma Esquiva restaura toda a ENE.
target: Hyvatia's attacks drain STA. Resonators take 20% more DMG when their STA falls below 20%. A successful Dodge restores all STA.

source: Os ataques à distância dos Gêmeos disparam uma rodada adicional de bombardeio.
target: The Twins' ranged attacks fire an additional round of bombing.

source: Os bônus fornecidos pelo Reino da Lança e Reino do Escudo são 50% mais fracos.
target: Bonuses provided by Realm of Spear and Realm of Shield are 50% weaker.

source: Os ecos com este efeito são tratados como se estivessem na mesma fileira.
target: Echoes with this effect are considered to be in the same row.

source: Os inimigos recebem 6% a menos de Dano.

Os inimigos recebem: ATQ da Rainha da Noite é aumentado em 10%. Este efeito é acumulável.

Derrotar um inimigo concede aos Ressonantes próximos da equipe 80% de Bônus de Dano por 5s.
target:
Enemies gain the following effect: Queen of the Night's ATK is increased by 10%. This effect is stackable.

Defeating an enemy grants nearby Resonators in the team 80% DMG Bonus for 5s.

source:
Os inimigos recebem: DEF da Rainha da Noite é aumentada em 10%. Este efeito é acumulável.

Derrotar um inimigo restaura 50% do máx. de HP do Ressonante.
target:
Enemies gain the following effect: Queen of the Night's DEF is increased by 10%. This effect is stackable.

Defeating an enemy restores 50% of the Resonator's Max HP.

source: Os inimigos recuperam continuamente sua Força de Vibração. Ao sofrerem Ruptura de Sintonia, a Taxa de Redução da Força de Vibração deles aumenta em 50% por 2s.
target: Enemies continuously recover their Vibration Strength. Upon being inflicted with Tune Break, their Vibration Strength Reduction Rate is increased by 50% for 2s.

source: Os inimigos sofrem 10% a menos de Dano.
Os inimigos sofrem 10% a menos de Dano. Este efeito fica desativado por 5s ao receber um Dano de Efeito Negativo.
target: Enemies take 10% less DMG. This effect is removed for 5s after taking Negative Status DMG.

source: Os inimigos sofrem 50% menos dano enquanto estiverem acima de 0 de Força de Vibração. ATQs Coordenados liberam uma onda de choque ao acertar, reduzindo a Força de Vibração do alvo em 7,5%.
target: Enemies take 50% less damage while above 0 Vibration Strength. Coordinated Attacks release a shockwave upon hit, reducing the target's Vibration Strength by 7.5%.

target: Enemies take 70% less damage while above 0 Vibration Strength. Coordinated Attacks release a shockwave upon hit, reducing the target's Vibration Strength by 7.5%.

source: Os inimigos sofrem 90% menos dano enquanto estiverem acima de 0 de Força de Vibração. ATQs Coordenados liberam uma onda de choque ao acertar, reduzindo a Força de Vibração do alvo em 7,5%.
target: Enemies take 90% less damage while above 0 Vibration Strength. Coordinated Attacks release a shockwave upon hit, reducing the target's Vibration Strength by 7.5%.

source: Os itens de Relíquia sobem de nível automaticamente e ficam mais poderosos ao cumprir certas condições. O Nível de Relíquia começa em 1 por padrão.
target: Relic items will automatically level up and grow more powerful after meeting certain conditions. Relic Level starts at 1 by default.

source: Os membros da Tríade Xuanfang também são conhecidos como Vigias Xuanfang
target: The members of Xuan Triad are also known as Xuan Watchers.

source: Os soldados responsáveis por guardar a Fortaleza Xuanfang são conhecidos como Guardas de Xuanfang.
target: The soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens.

source:
Osezno Aflechado obtiene los siguientes efectos: Beringal del Bosque recibe un 50% menos de daño.
Al derrotar a un enemigo, la DEF de los personajes del equipo aumenta un 10%. Este efecto se puede acumular.
target:
Spearback provides the following effect: Feilian Beringal takes 50% less DMG.
Defeating an enemy increases DEF of Resonators in the team by 10%. This effect is stackable.

source: Para cada 10 ecos obtidos (exceto pelo Recrutamento de Eco, Loja ou Bênção Fantasma), receba 2 Cristais de Frequência.
target: Before Daily Coupon settlement, gain 2 Frequency Crystals for every 10 Echoes obtained.

source: Para cada 10 ecos obtidos (exceto pelo Recrutamento de Eco, Loja ou Bênção Fantasma), receba 500 Cupons da Terra dos Sonhos extras.
target: Before Daily Coupon settlement, gain 500 Dreamland Coupons for every 10 Echoes obtained.

source: Para cada acúmulo de "Aflição: Estridência Fotônica", o alvo sofre dano igual a 4% do ATQ de Rover por segundo, acumulando até 20 vezes. Este efeito dura 10s.
target: For each stack of Affliction: Spectro Frazzle, the target takes DMG equal to 4% of Rover's ATK per second, stacking up to 20 times. This effect lasts 10s.

source: Para cada eco de raridade azul no campo, sempre que um Item de Troca for trocado, há 5% de chance de gerar um eco de mesmo nome, acumulando até 5 vezes.
target: For every blue-rarity Echo on the field, whenever an Item of Exchange is Exchanged, there is a 5% chance to generate an Echo of the same name, stacking up to 5 times.

source: Participante en los combates de gladiadores, conocido por su valentía y destreza. Lucha impulsado por el deseo de victoria y gloria.
target: Participants in Gladiator matches. They are renowned for their strength and battle prowess and driven by an unyielding thirst for victory and glory.

source: Participantes das batalhas de gladiadores. Celebrados por sua força e destreza em combate, são movidos por uma sede insaciável de triunfo e glória.
target: Participants in Gladiator matches. They are renowned for their strength and battle prowess and driven by an unyielding thirst for victory and glory.

source: Pendant 5 secondes, le Bonus de Dégâts de tous les ennemis sauf Erreur intarissable est augmenté de 5 %, la DEF est diminuée de 5 %. L'effet peut être cumulé 20 fois.
target: All enemies except Fallacy of No Return gain 5% DMG Bonus and have their DEF reduced by 5% every 5s, stacking up to 20 times.

source: Pendant l'Illumination éphémère, l'Attaque normale - Illumination éphémère et la Contre-attaque d'esquive - Illumination éphémère de Qingxiao sont disponibles.
target: While Qingxiao is in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence become available.

source: Pendant la Vélocité astrale, lancez la Libération résonatrice Édit céleste : Surcharge pour obtenir des points de Taux de résonance supplémentaires.
target: When in Starlume Acceleration, casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive additionally recovers Resonance Rate.

source: Pendant le Mode Feu jaune, vous pouvez effectuer des attaques à distance.
target: Perform ranged attacks when in Yellow Light Mode.

source: Pendant le Mode Feu rouge, vous pouvez lancer des attaques de mêlée.
target: Perform melee attacks when in Red Light Mode.

source: Pendant le Mode standard, Mornye peut obtenir de l'Énergie de masse au repos.
target: While in her default Baseline Mode, Mornye gains Rest Mass Energy.

source: Pendant le mode Chasseresse, les dégâts critiques de Rebecca augmentent de {0}.
target: While in the Huntress mode, Rebecca's Crit. DMG increases by {0}.

source: Pendant le mode Guts, les dégâts infligés par Rebecca ignorent {1} de la DEF de la cible.
target: While in the Guts mode, Rebecca ignores {1} of the target's DEF.

source: Percer les ennemis sur son trajectoire et infliger plusieurs fois de Dégâts Spectro.
target: Pierces through enemies along its trajectory, dealing multiple instances of damage to enemies at intersections.

source: Perfura inimigos ao longo de sua trajetória, causando múltiplas instâncias de dano a inimigos nas intersecções.
target: Pierces through enemies along its trajectory, dealing multiple instances of damage to enemies at intersections.

source: Permanecer no ar inflige 1 acúmulo de Erosão Pneumática ao Ressonante ativo a cada 1,5s.
target: Staying in mid-air inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the active Resonator every 1.5s.

source: Permanecer no chão inflige 1 acúmulo de Erosão Pneumática ao Ressonante ativo a cada 1,5s. Todos os acúmulos de Erosão Pneumática são removidos quando estão no ar.
target: Staying on the ground inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the active Resonator every 1.5s. All stacks of Aero Erosion are removed when in mid-air.

source: Permite transformarse brevemente en el personaje correspondiente al factor de resonancia o invocarlo para lanzar su habilidad especial. En estado mimético, el daño recibido se reduce un 50%.
target: Briefly Morph into or summon the Resonator of the Resonance Factor and cast their special skills. DMG taken is reduced by 50% while Morphed.

source: Personnel du Bureau Sécurité Publique responsable des questions de sécurité dans leurs juridictions.
target: Public Security Bureau staff who are responsible for the security issues of their jurisdictions.

source: Phoebe stellt 60 Punkte „Göttliche Stimmen“ wieder her, wenn sie den Schweren Angriff Absolutionslitanei oder den Resonanzskill Offensichtliche Beichte einsetzt.
target: Casting Heavy Attack Absolution Litany or Resonance Skill Utter Confession restores 60 Divine Voice.

source:
Phrolova entra em Acorde Resolutivo após lançar Coda Escarlate.
Quando no estado de Acorde Resolutivo, Valsa das Profundezas Renegadas fica disponível.
target:
Phrolova enters Resolving Chord after casting Scarlet Coda.
When in the Resolving Chord state, Waltz of Forsaken Depths becomes available.

source: Pode ser detonado pelo ATQ Pesado Detonar, causando Dano Criogênico.
target: Can be detonated by Heavy Attack Detonate, dealing Glacio DMG.

source: Poder remanescente da Leviatã, a Trenodiana, que se escondeu dentro da pedra preciosa de Ragunna no capacete de Mya após escapar de sua forma destruída.
target: Lingering power of the Threnodian Leviathan. After escaping from Mya's broken form, it concealed itself within the Ragunna gemstone on her helmet.

source: Por cada acumulación de Afección: Espectro estridente, el objetivo recibe daño equivalente al 4% del ATQ de Errante por segundo, acumulable hasta 20 veces. Este efecto dura 10 s.
target: For each stack of Affliction: Spectro Frazzle, the target takes DMG equal to 4% of Rover's ATK per second, stacking up to 20 times. This effect lasts 10s.

source: Por cada fase, se obtienen Cupones del parque equivalentes al número de Cristales de frecuencia.
target: Receive Dreamland Coupons equal to the number of Frequency Crystals in each Phase.

source: Por defecto, Galbrena se encuentra en el estado Umbral. En este estado puede acumular Llama remanente y Llama del pecado.
target: By default, Galbrena is in Threshold State, and in this state, she accumulates Afterflame and Sinflame.

source: Por defecto, Mornye se encuetra en Modo básico y puede obtener Energía de masa en reposo.
target: While in her default Baseline Mode, Mornye gains Rest Mass Energy.

source: Por padrão, Galbrena está em Estado de Limiar, e neste estado, ela acumula Recaída e Chama do Pecado.
target: By default, Galbrena is in Threshold State, and in this state, she accumulates Afterflame and Sinflame.

source: Por ter despertado seu Poder de Ressonância em tenra idade, Yangyang se tornou capaz de sentir e interpretar uma forma especial de “corrente”, que transporta vários tipos de informação, inclusive vozes e emoções.
target: Since Yangyang Awakened her Forte at a young age, she became capable of sensing and interpreting a unique form of "streams," which carry various kinds of information, including voices and emotions.

source: Potencia a las máquinas de combate cercanas dentro de un cierto alcance mientras está activa.
target: This type of Tactic enhances nearby Combat Machines within a certain range when active.

source: Potencia el efecto de la Energía de resonancia.
target: Boosts the effect of Resonance Energy.

source: Pro Phase erhältst du so viele Traumland-Gutscheine, wie du aktuell Frequenzkristalle besitzt.
target: Receive Dreamland Coupons equal to the number of Frequency Crystals in each Phase.
The chance of triggering a Critical Hit when dealing damage.

source: Projette en continu du feu vers l'avant pour infliger des Dégâts Havoc. Ne peut pas bénéficier des bonus de vitesse d'attaque.
target: Continuously sprays fire forward, dealing Havoc DMG. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.

source: Puede detonarse con un Ataque cargado Detonar, infligiendo Daño Gelio.
target: Can be detonated by Heavy Attack Detonate, dealing Glacio DMG.

source: Puissance durable du Léviathan Réprimantum. Après s'être défait de la forme brisée de Mya, il s'est dissimulé dans la gemme de Ragunna, sur son casque.
target: Lingering power of the Threnodian Leviathan. After escaping from Mya's broken form, it concealed itself within the Ragunna gemstone on her helmet.

Qingxiao hält bis zu {0} Pkt. Herzschwertwille.
Das Verursachen von Schaden mit Standardangriff: Flüchtige Transzendenz oder Ausweichangriff: Flüchtige Transzendenz gewährt Herzschwertwille.
target:
Qingxiao can hold up to {0} points.
Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence or Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence grants Heart Sword Intent.

source:
Qingxiao kann bis zu {0} Pkt. halten.
Das Verursachen von Schaden durch Skills der Gezogenen Haltung gewährt Schwertkadenz.
Im Zustand Flüchtige Transzendenz kann kein Schwertkadenz erhalten werden.
target:
Qingxiao can hold up to {0} points.
Dealing damage with Drawn Stance skills grants Sword Cadence.
Sword Cadence cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

source:
Qingxiao kann bis zu {0} Pkt. halten.
Wenn Skills der Eingesteckten Haltung Schaden verursachen, wird Qin-Herz erhalten.
Im Zustand Flüchtige Transzendenz kann Qin-Herz nicht erhalten werden.
target:
Qingxiao can hold up to {0} points.
Dealing damage with Sheathed Stance skills grants Qin Heart.
Qin Heart cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

source: Quais et appontements où les navettes de la Cité de Xuanfang embarquent passagers et marchandises. Ils se situent généralement aux points de départ et d'arrivée des lignes de transport.
target: The docking platforms and wharves where the Shuttles of Xuanfang Hold board passengers and load cargo. They are typically situated at the starting and ending points of transport routes.

source: Quand Carlotta attaque une cible marquée par la « Déconstruction », ces attaques ignorent 18 % de la DEF de celle-ci.
target: Dealing DMG to targets inflicted with Deconstruction ignores 18% of their DEF.

source: Quand Danjin attaque une cible affectée par l' « Empreinte flamboyante », ses dégâts infligés sont augmentés de 20 %.
target: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's Incinerating Will, her damage dealt is increased by 20%.

source: Quand Fleurdelys a 120 points de « Détermination », la Libération résonatrice « Prières sincères de chevaleresse » deviendra la Libération résonatrice « Rage des marées ».
target: When Conviction reaches 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.

source: Quand certains ennemis ont moins de 50 % de PV, ils vont invoquer les autres pour participer au combat.
target: Some enemies will summon reinforcements when their HP drops below 50%.

source: Quand elle est activée, ce type de tactique améliore les machines de combat dans une certaine portée.
target: This type of Tactic enhances nearby Combat Machines within a certain range when active.

source: Quand l'Effet concertant est déclenché, si les deux personnages ont le même type d'attribut Fusion, la Cantate Fusionnelle inflige des Dégâts Fusion à l'adversaire.
target: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of Fusion, it triggers the Fusion flurry, which inflicts Fusion DMG.

source: Quand l'attaque du membre touche l'ennemi, ce dernier invoque un éclair qui diminue 10 % de PV du membre. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois toutes les 15 secondes.
target: When a Resonator hits an enemy, a lightning strike is summoned at the spot to attack the Resonator, dealing DMG equal to 10% of the Resonator's Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.

source: Quand l'attaque du membre touche l'ennemi, ce dernier invoque un éclair qui diminue 10 % de PV du membre. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois toutes les 5 secondes.
target: Upon hitting an enemy, a lightning strike is summoned to where they hit, dealing damage equal to 10% of the Resonator's max HP to Resonators themselves. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

source: Quand l'attaque du membre touche l'ennemi, ce dernier invoque un éclair qui diminue 20 % de PV du membre. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois toutes les 5 secondes.
target: Upon hitting an enemy, a lightning strike is summoned to where they hit, dealing damage equal to 20% of the Resonator's max HP to Resonators themselves. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

source: Quand l'attaque du personnage touche une cible, un éclair sera invoqué immédiatement par l'ennemi pour attaquer le membre de l'équipe. 10 % des ses PV seront perdus. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois toutes les 10 secondes.
target: When a Resonator hits an enemy, a lightning strike is summoned at the spot to attack the Resonator, dealing DMG equal to 10% of the Resonator's Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.

source: Quand l'ennemi est paralysé, il va infliger des Dégâts égaux à 200 % de son ATQ aux personnages autour de lui.
target: When enemies are Immobilized, they deal DMG equal to 200% of their ATK to nearby Resonators.

source: Quand l'ennemi obtient encore une fois le Taux de vibration, il inflige 300 % de dégâts équivalents à son ATQ aux membres de l'équipe autour de lui.
target: When about to recover from being Immobilized, enemies deal damage equal to 300% of their ATK to nearby Resonators.

source: Quand l'Énergie concertante est pleine, changez le membre actif dans le combat pour lancer la Compétence d'Outro du membre qui quitte le combat et vider son Énergie concertante, le membre qui entera dans le combat va lancer sa Compétence d'Intro.
target: Switch Resonator when Concerto Energy is full to trigger the exiting Resonator's Outro Skill, and consume all the Concerto Energy to trigger the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill.

source: Quand le Taux de vibration est vidé, l'ennemi sera Paralysé. Il devient immobile pendant une certaine durée.
target: When the Vibration Strength is depleted, the enemy is Immobilized and cannot take any action for a period of time.

source: Quand le Taux de vibration n'est pas 0. Chaque fois vous infligez des dégâts, vous obtenez 3 % de PV. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois toutes les 10 secondes.
target: When Vibration Strength is above 0, enemies recover 3% of their max HP each time they deal damage. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.

source: Quand le Taux de vibration n'est pas 0. Chaque fois vous infligez des dégâts, vous obtenez 6 % de PV. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois toutes les 10 secondes.
target: When Vibration Strength is above 0, enemies recover 6% of their max HP each time they deal damage. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.

source: Quand le bouclier de Fleurdelys a été détruit, elle inflige des Dégâts égaux à 200 % de son ATQ aux personnages autour.
target: When Fleurdelys's Shield is totally depleted, it deals DMG equal to 200% of her ATK to the nearby Resonators.

source: Quand le membre actif de l'équipe se trouve sur le sol et il est dans une certaine portée à proximité de l'ennemi, il perd 1,2 % de ses PV maximum toutes les 0,5 secondes.
target: When the active Resonator is on the ground and within a certain range of an enemy, they take DMG equal to 1.2% of their Max HP every 0.5s.

source: Quand le membre actif est en l'air, 1 pile de l'Effet de l'érosion aéronautique lui seront imposées toutes les 1,5 secondes.
target: Staying in mid-air inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the active Resonator every 1.5s.

source: Quand le membre actif lance l'Attaque lourde, 2 piles de l'Effet de givre glaçant lui seront imposées. Quand la Libération résonatrice est lancée, toutes les piles de l'Effet de givre glaçant seront supprimées.
target: Casting Heavy Attack inflicts 2 stacks of Glacio Chafe on the Resonator. Casting Resonance Liberation removes all stacks of Glacio Chafe.

source: Quand le membre actif lance la Compétence résonatrice, 2 piles de l'Effet de givre glaçant lui seront imposées. Quand la Libération résonatrice est lancée, toutes les piles de l'Effet de givre glaçant seront supprimées.
target: Casting Resonance Skill inflicts 2 stacks of Glacio Chafe on the Resonator. Casting Resonance Liberation removes all stacks of Glacio Chafe.

source: Quand le personnage est au sol, 1 pile d'Effet de givre glaçant lui sera imposée chaque seconde. Quand le personnage est gelé, sa DEF est réduite à 0. Quand le personnage est en l'air, toutes les piles d'Effet de givre glaçant seront effacés.
target: Active Resonators receive 1 stack of Glacio Chafe for every 1s on the ground and their DEF is reduced to 0 when Frozen. All stacks of Glacio Chafe are removed when in mid-air.

source: Quand le personnage est au sol, 1 pile d'Effet de givre glaçant lui sera imposée toutes les 2 secondes. Quand le personnage est gelé, sa DEF est réduite à 0. Quand le personnage est en l'air, toutes les piles d'Effet de givre glaçant seront effacées.
target: Active Resonators receive 1 stack of Glacio Chafe for every 2s on the ground and their DEF is reduced to 0 when Frozen. All stacks of Glacio Chafe are removed when in mid-air.

source: Quand le personnage se trouve sur le sol, 1 pile de l'Effet de l'érosion aéronautique lui sera imposée toutes les 1,5 secondes. Quand le personnage est en l'air, toutes les piles de l'effet seront supprimées.
target: Staying on the ground inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the active Resonator every 1.5s. All stacks of Aero Erosion are removed when in mid-air.

source: Quand un autre Écho sur le terrain a été retiré, la production quotidienne de coupons est augmentée de 2. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois chaque jour.
target: When a unit is Removed, increase its own Daily Coupon yield by 2, up to 1 time per day.

source: Quand un membre actif de l'équipe est attaqué, 1 « Mur de protection » sera consommé pour réduire les dégâts subis cette fois.
target: When the active character on the team is attacked, 1 Rocksteady Shield is consumed to reduce the damage taken.

source: Quand vous lancez l'Attaque lourde « Liturgie d'absolution », la Compétence résonatrice « Confession complète », vous obtenez 60 points de « Voix Divine ».
target: Casting Heavy Attack Absolution Litany or Resonance Skill Utter Confession restores 60 Divine Voice.

source: Quand vous lancez la Compétence résonatrice, vous consommez 10% de PV pour obtenir 5 points d'Énergie résonatrice. L'effet peut être déclenché 1 fois par seconde.
target: Resonators lose HP equal to 10% of their current HP and restore 5 Resonance Energy after casting Resonance Skill. This effect is applicable once every second.

source: Quand vous lancez la Compétence résonatrice, vous consommez 20% de PV pour obtenir 5 points d'Énergie résonatrice. Cet effet peut-être déclenché 1 fois par seconde.
target: Resonators lose HP equal to 20% of their current HP and restore 5 Resonance Energy after casting Resonance Skill. This effect is applicable once every second.

source: Quando Aalto passa pela Névoa ou Portão do Dilema, ele entra em Arremetida Nebulosa.
target: When Aalto passes through Mist or Gate of Quandary, he enters the Mistcloak Dash.

source: Quando Aflição: Laceração no alvo atinge 20 acúmulos, a próxima vez que ele sofrer dano removerá todos os acúmulos de Laceração, cada um causando dano igual a 50% do ATQ de Rover.
target: When Affliction: Laceration on the target reaches 20 stacks, the next time it takes damage removes all Laceration stacks, each dealing DMG equal to 50% of Rover's ATK.

source: Quando Buling obtém Yin Menor e Yang Menor, ela entra no estado Equilíbrio Yin-Yang, substituindo sua Liberação de Ressonância - Feitição Trovão Clarão por Liberação de Ressonância - Feitição Trovão Clarão: Harmonia.
target: When Buling obtains Minor Yin and Minor Yang, she enters the Yin-Yang Balance state, replacing her Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell with Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell: Harmony.

source: Quando Ciaccona ou Sílfide de Conjunto executa Concerto Solo, concede 24% de Bônus de Dano Pneumático a todos os Ressonantes próximos da equipe. Este efeito não pode ser acumulado.
target: When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

source: Quando Danjin ataca um alvo com a Habilidade de Ressonância Vontade Incineradora, o dano que ela causa aumenta em 20%.
target: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's Incinerating Will, her damage dealt is increased by 20%.

source: Quando Fleurdelys atingir 120 pontos de Convicção, a Liberação de Ressonância: As Orações do Guerreiro Comovido será substituída pela Liberação de Ressonância - Lâmina da Ventania Uivante.
target: When Conviction reaches 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.

source: Quando Fleurdelys está com pouca vida, ganha um Escudo equivalente a 50% do seu máx. de HP. Diferentes zonas do campo fornecem vários aprimoramentos para os Ressonantes.
target: When Fleurdelys is at low health, she gains a Shield equal to 50% of her Max HP. Different zones on the field provide various buffs for Resonators.

source: Quando Hyvatia está no ar, a Taxa de Acúmulo de Dissonância aumenta em 100%, mas seu ATQ também aumenta em 20%.
target: When Hyvatia is in mid-air, the Off-Tune Buildup Rate against it is increased by 100%, but its ATK is also increased by 20%.

source: Quando Hyvatia está no ar, a Taxa de Acúmulo de Dissonância aumenta em 100%, mas seu ATQ também aumenta em 40%.
target: When Hyvatia is in mid-air, the Off-Tune Buildup Rate against it is increased by 100%, but its ATK is also increased by 40%.

source: Quando Hyvatia está no ar, a Taxa de Acúmulo de Dissonância diminui em 20%, mas seu ATQ também diminui em 30%.
target: When Hyvatia is in mid-air, the Off-Tune Buildup Rate against it is decreased by 20%, but its ATK is also decreased by 30%.

source: Quando Hyvatia está no ar, a Taxa de Acúmulo de Dissonância diminui em 30%, mas seu ATQ também diminui em 30%.
target: When Hyvatia is in mid-air, the Off-Tune Buildup Rate against it is decreased by 30%, but its ATK is also decreased by 30%.

source: Quando Impulso - Preparação da Sobremesa atinge {0} acúmulos, remove todos os acúmulos para executar Combo - Golpe de Sobremesa {1} {Cus:Sap,S=vez P=vezes SapTag=1}.
target: When Boost - Dessert Prep reaches {0} stacks, remove all stacks to launch Combo - Dessert Strike {1} {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=1}.

source: Quando Qingxiao estiver no estado de Transcendência Efêmera, desbloqueia ATQ Básico: Transcendência Efêmera e Contra-ATQ Evasivo: Transcendência Efêmera.
target: While Qingxiao is in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence become available.

source: Quando Qiuyuan possui 400 pontos de Solilóquio do Espadachim, ele obtém o efeito Sombra de Bambu, permitindo que todos os Ressonantes ativos próximos da equipe ganhem 30% de Bônus de Dano de Habilidade de Eco por 30s.
target: When Qiuyuan holds 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy, he obtains the Bamboo's Shade effect, allowing all nearby active Resonators in the team to gain 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.

source: Quando Ressonantes entram no Reino da Ressonância, Fleurdelys imediatamente recebe um Escudo equivalente a 10% do máx. de HP.
target: When Resonators enter Realm of Resonance, Fleurdelys immediately gains a Shield equal to 10% of her Max HP.

source: Quando Ressonantes estão no Reino da Ressonância, todos os Ressonantes da equipe sofrem dano equivalente a 2% do máx. de HP a cada segundo.
target: When Resonators are in Realm of Resonance, all Resonators in the team take DMG equal to 2% of their Max HP each second.

source:
Quando Zani está nos seguintes estados, mantenha pressionada a Habilidade de Ressonância para entrar na Postura Pronta.
- Quando não estiver em Modo Infernal e a Energia Redundante estiver cheia.
- Quando estiver em Modo Infernal.
target:
When Zani is under the following states, hold Resonance Skill to enter Ready Stance.
- While not in the Inferno Mode and Redundant Energy is full.
- While in the Inferno Mode.

source: Quando a Energia de Ressonância está cheia, a poderosa Liberação de Ressonância fica disponível.
target: When Resonance Energy is full, the powerful Resonance Liberation becomes available.

source: Quando a Força de Vibração está acima de 0, inimigos recuperam 3% do seu HP Máx. cada vez que causam dano. Este efeito pode ser ativado uma vez a cada 10s.
target: When Vibration Strength is above 0, enemies recover 3% of their max HP each time they deal damage. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.

source: Quando a Força de Vibração está acima de 0, os inimigos recuperam 6% de seu HP Máx. cada vez que causam dano. Este efeito pode ser ativado uma vez a cada 10s.
target: When Vibration Strength is above 0, enemies recover 6% of their max HP each time they deal damage. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.

source: Quando a Força de Vibração é esgotada, o inimigo fica imobilizado e não pode realizar nenhuma ação por um período de tempo.
target: When the Vibration Strength is depleted, the enemy is Immobilized and cannot take any action for a period of time.

source: Quando alvos marcados por Enredamento Invisível recebem dano direto de Ressonantes, Chisa inflige {0} {Cus:Sap,S=acúmulo P=acúmulos SapTag=0} de Ruína Aniquilante neles. Este efeito pode ser ativado até uma vez a cada {1}s.
target: When targets marked by Unseen Snare take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts {0} {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of Havoc Bane on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every {1}s.

source: Quando atingidos por uma Bolha Restritiva, a DEF dos Ressonantes é reduzida em 100%.
target: When hit by a Restraining Bubble, Resonators' DEF is reduced by 100%.

source: Quando estiverem dentro de um certo alcance dos inimigos, os Ressonantes sofrem dano igual a 3,2% de seu HP Máx. a cada 0,5s.
target: While within a certain range around enemies, Resonators take damage equal to 3.2% of their max HP every 0.5s.

source: Quando for atingido pelo ataque do Reator Deteriorado, reduz a velocidade de movimento de todos os Ressonantes da equipe por 5 segundos.
target: Reactor Husk reduces the Movement Speed of all Resonators in the team on hit for 5s.

source: Quando for atingido pelo ataque do Reator Deteriorado, reduz a velocidade de movimento de todos os Ressonantes da equipe por 8 segundos.
target: Reactor Husk reduces the Movement Speed of all Resonators in the team on hit for 8s.

source: Quando inimigos ficam imobilizados, causam dano equivalente a 200% do ATQ aos Ressonantes próximos.
target: When enemies are Immobilized, they deal DMG equal to 200% of their ATK to nearby Resonators.

source: Quando o Escudo de Fleurdelys é esgotado, causa dano equivalente a 200% do ATQ aos Ressonantes próximos.
target: When Fleurdelys's Shield is totally depleted, it deals DMG equal to 200% of her ATK to the nearby Resonators.

source: Quando o Ressonante ativo da equipe é atacado, 1 Escudo Rochafirme é consumido para reduzir o dano recebido.
target: When the active character on the team is attacked, 1 Rocksteady Shield is consumed to reduce the damage taken.

source: Quando o Ressonante ativo está no chão e dentro de um certo alcance de um inimigo, sofre dano equivalente a 1,2% do seu máx. de HP a cada 0,5s.
target: When the active Resonator is on the ground and within a certain range of an enemy, they take DMG equal to 1.2% of their Max HP every 0.5s.

source: Quando o efeito de concerto se aciona, se ambos os Ressonantes tiverem o mesmo tipo de atributo Voltaico, ele ativa a rajada Voltaica, que causa dano Voltaico.
target: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of Electro, it triggers the Electro flurry, which deals Electro damage.

source: Quando o efeito de concerto é acionado, se ambos os Ressonantes tiverem o mesmo tipo de atributo Pneumático, ele aciona a rajada aérea, que inflige Pneumático no dano do alvo.
target: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of Aero, it triggers the Aero flurry, which inflicts Aero on the target Damage.

source: Quando o efeito de concerto é acionado, se ambos os Ressonantes tiverem o tipo de atributo Fotônico, ele aciona a rajada Fotônico, que causa dano Fotônico.
target: When Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of Spectro, it triggers the Spectro flurry, which deals Spectro damage.

source: Quando o efeito de concerto é ativado, se ambos os Ressonantes tiverem o mesmo tipo de atributo Aniquilante, ele ativa fúria Aniquilante, que causa dano Aniquilante.
target: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of Havoc, it triggers Havoc Flurry, which deals Havoc damage.

source: Quando o efeito de concerto é ativado, se ambos os Ressonantes tiverem o mesmo tipo de atributo de fusão, ele dispara a Rajada Térmica, que inflige dano Térmico.
target: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of Fusion, it triggers the Fusion flurry, which inflicts Fusion DMG.

source:
Quando o efeito de concerto é ativado, se os tipos de atributo dos dois Ressonantes forem Fotônico e Aniquilante, ele ativa o repetição bifásica.
O Dano de Atributo causado por toda a equipe aumenta em 20% por 12 segundos.
target:
When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Characters are Spectro and Havoc, it triggers the Diphase Replay.
Attribute damage dealt by the entire team is increased by 20% for 12 seconds.

source: Quando o efeito de concerto é ativado, se os tipos de atributo dos dois Ressonantes forem ambos Criogênicos, ativa-se o Concerto Criogênico, causando Dano Criogênico ao alvo.
target: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Characters are both Glacio, the Glacio Concerto is triggered, causing Glacio DMG to the target.

source: Quando prestes a se recuperar de Imobilização, inimigos causam dano igual a 300% do seu ATQ aos Ressonantes próximos.

target: One of the signs that heralds the coming of a Dark Tide. It's when countless Tacet Discords swarm beneath the Blightcloud, descending upon Septimont in waves of destruction.

target: A globally popular competitive sport that puts both the strength and endurance of its participants to the test.

target: A traveling performance group specializing in the traditional Liondance. They take commissions from both the Jinzhou Theater and private clients to support themselves and cover their travel expenses.

source: Um grupo de mercenários na Nova Federação liderado por Calcharo.
target: A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.

source: Um item precioso guardado pela Sentinela, contendo dados vitais de legado sobre as Sentinelas e a civilização.

source: Um item precioso guardado pela Sentinela, contendo dados vitais de legado sobre as Sentinelas e a civilização.
Um mundo construído sobre milhares de Reverberações. Um domínio de frequências em decadência. Um lugar onde Phrolova encontrou renascimento e que agora se tornou parte de sua existência.
target: A world built upon thousands of Reverberations. A domain of decaying frequencies. A place where Phrolova found rebirth, which has now become a part of her existence.

source: Um nome majestoso para a cidade de Septimont, empoleirada no topo do Morro Capitólio. Seus habitantes são renomados mestres escultores, caçadores habilidosos e gladiadores extraordinários que celebram o heroísmo.
target: A majestic name for the city of Septimont, perched atop Capitoline Hill. Its people are renowned as master sculptors, skilled hunters, and awe-inspiring gladiators who celebrate heroism.

source: Um poema épico antigo de Rinascita. Foi pioneiro na mistura de vários folclores regionais com os contos do Sentinela, incluindo os primeiros relatos das origens do Carnaval.
target: An ancient epic poem of Rinascita. It pioneered blending various regional folkfore with the tales of the Sentinel, including the first accounts of the Carnevale's origins.
