source: Um protetor dedicado da Magistrada, que serve também como secretário pessoal.
target: A dedicated protector of the Magistrate, also serving as their personal secretary.

source: Um roteiro de peça dado por Phrolova. Todo ator tem seu papel designado, e todas as histórias se desenrolam exatamente como escrito, a menos que...
target: A play script given by Phrolova. Every actor has their assigned role, and all stories unfold exactly as written, unless...

source: Um ser estranho que reside dentro da Caixa Mágica carregada por Roccia. Parece ter nascido das inspirações imbuídas nos objetos coletados dentro da caixa.
target: A strange being that resides within the Magic Box carried by Roccia. It appears to be born from the inspirations imbued in the collected objects inside the box.

source: Um tipo de Dissonância Transgressora nascida da Maré Sombria.
target: A type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.

source: Um tipo de Exoenxame originário das estruturas neurais do Exotitã. Acredita-se que incorporem fragmentos de sua consciência.
target: A type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.

source: Um tipo de Matriz Estelar especial usada para conter os erros e dados descartados do Sistema Tétis.
target: A type of special Stellar Matrix used to contain the errors and discarded data of Tethys System.

source: Um tipo de dano especial que pode ser aprimorado por alguns Fatores de Ressonância.
target: A special DMG type that can be enhanced by some Resonance Factors.

source: Uma Criatura Remanente que lembra uma udumbara branca. Pode se comunicar com Baizhi por meio de telepatia.
target: A Remnant Creature reminiscent of a white udumbara. It can communicate with Baizhi through telepathy.

source: Uma Criatura Remanescente selada dentro da Lâmpada da Vida de Jingran, ligada a ele através de um pacto especial.
target: A Remnant Creature sealed within Jingran's Life Lamp, bound to him through a special pact.

source: Uma Garota Consegue o Que Quer!
target: A Girl Gets What She Wants!

source: Uma arte marcial que incorpora a sabedoria taoísta, onde os praticantes se harmonizam com os ritmos da natureza para desenvolver força equilibrada do corpo e da mente.
target: A martial art embodying Taoist wisdom, where practitioners harmonize with nature's rhythms to develop balanced strength of body and mind.

source: Uma arte marcial única praticada por Yuanwu, conhecida por seus golpes pesados e ferozes. No entanto, apenas aqueles que modulam sua força com controle preciso podem manejá-la sem se machucar.

source: Uma atividade realizada nas profundezas de Sonúmia. Você foi convidado para ser juiz, mas a identidade do anfitrião permanece um total mistério.
target: An activity held in the depths of Somnoire. You've been invited to be a judge, but the identity of the host remains a complete mystery.

source: Uma cadeia de montanhas que marca a fronteira de Septimont, profundamente corrompida pela Maré Sombria. Apenas os gladiadores mais ousados se aventuram aqui para treinar sob suas condições severas.
target: A chain of mountains marking Septimont's edge, severely corrupted by the Dark Tide. Only the most daring Gladiators venture here seeking to train in its harsh conditions.

source: Uma cidade perdida de Gladiadores localizada nas Terras Desoladas, nos níveis inferiores do Planalto Sangrento.
target: A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.

source: Uma colossal Dissonância Transgressora semelhante a uma baleia. Apesar de sua natureza gentil, seu tamanho gigantesco pode inadvertidamente causar destruição significativa.

source: Uma cópia do eco que compartilha a colheita de Cupom Diário e Atributo Onírico. Não possui habilidades nem efeitos de buff.

source: Uma explosão ocorre ao redor do Reator Deteriorado a cada 8s.
target: An explosion occurs around the Reactor Husk every 8s.

source: Uma extensão especial que coleta todos os sonhos em Solaris desde que passou a existir. É gerenciada por dois Guardiões.
target: A special expanse that collects all the dreams in Solaris since it came into being. It is managed by two Gatekeepers.

source: Uma forma de energia pura com frequências completas. A informação que carrega transcende o tempo e o espaço, perdurando em um estado estável e imutável.
target: A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.

source: Uma frequência única de Intenção de Espada separada por Qingxiao, condensando o seu Poder de Ressonância mais essencial e puro.
target: A unique frequency of Sword Intent split off by Qingxiao, condensing her most essential and purest Resonance Energy.

source: Uma grande construção localizada no eixo central de Jinzhou. Não apenas reserva as funções de recepção importante e discussão de questões importantes, como também se estabelece como símbolo de esperança para o povo de Huanglong.
target: A grand construction located in the central axis of Jinzhou. Not only it reserves the functions of important reception and discussion of major issues, but also sets itself as the symbol of hope for the people of Huanglong.

source: Uma instalação experimental subaquática isolada construída pelo Fractiverso e pela Ordem, onde ambos perseguem ambições secretas sob o pretexto de reprocessamento e produção de Eco Público.
target: A secluded underwater experiment facility built by the Fractsidus and the Order, where they both pursue hidden ambitions under the guise of Common Echo reprocessing and production.

source: Uma mala enorme que nunca se afasta de Roccia, abrigando vários adereços de palco, roteiros de peças e Pero.
target: A massive suitcase that never leaves Roccia's side, housing various stage props, play scripts, and Pero.

source: Uma medalha concedida pelos governantes de Septimont exclusivamente aos Gladiadores que demonstram desempenho excepcional na caça contra a Maré Sombria. É considerada uma das maiores honras entre os Gladiadores.
target: A medal bestowed by the rulers of Septimont exclusively to Gladiators who demonstrate exceptional performance in the hunt against the Dark Tide. It is regarded as one of the highest honors among Gladiators.

source: Uma praia onde poetas e músicos de Rinascita enterram seus instrumentos antigos.
target: A shore where Rinascitan poets and musicians bury their retired instruments.

source: Uma região localizada entre Mengzhou e Jinzhou. É considerada uma passagem vital entre as duas cidades, e também foi um ponto estratégico para interceptar Dissonâncias Transgressoras.
target: A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.

source: Uma taverna popular situada no bairro dos plebeus, famosa por sua bebida característica "Solis". Gladiadores frequentemente lutam lá, e o perdedor paga a conta.
target: A popular tavern situated in the commoner neighborhood, famous for its signature drink "Solis." Gladiators often spar there, with the loser footing the bill.

source: Umfasst Seraphisches Duett: Ouvertüre und Seraphisches Duett: Encore.
target: Includes Seraphic Duet: Overture and Seraphic Duet: Encore.

source: Umfasst Spectro-Frazzle-SCH, Chaosfluch-SCH, Fusionsausbruch-SCH, Glacio-Reibung-SCH, Elektroflamme-SCH, Aero-Erosion-SCH
target: Includes Spectro Frazzle DMG, Havoc Bane DMG, Fusion Burst DMG, Glacio Chafe DMG, Electro Flare DMG, and Aero Erosion DMG.

source: Umfasst Synchronstoß: Eins mit der Bewaffnung und Synchronstoß: Ruf der Dämmerung.
target: Includes Sync Strike: Armament Merge and Sync Strike: Call of Dawn.

source: Un Beringal del Bosque invocado que permanece en el lugar para infligir Daño Aero a los enemigos cercanos. No puede beneficiarse de bonificaciones de velocidad de ataque.
target: A summoned Feilian Beringal that stays in one place to deal Aero DMG to surrounding enemies. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.

source: Un Eco común en forma de gran cuerno. El estruendo agudo y prolongado del Cornum se usa para señalar el comienzo o la conclusión de operaciones de cacería a gran escala.
target: A Common Echo in the form of a large horn. Hornett's high-pitched and lengthy blare is used to signal the beginning or the conclusion of large-scale hunting operations.

source: Un Eco nacido de la reverberación de un héroe caído, fusionado con su antigua armadura. Anhela revivir la gloria del combate.
target: An Echo formed from the Reverberation of a fallen hero, fused into his armor. It longs to relive the thrill of glorious battle.

source: Un Feilian Berigal sera invoqué et il attaque des cibles pour infliger des Dégâts Aero. Ne peut pas bénéficier des bonus de vitesse d'attaque.
target: A summoned Feilian Beringal that stays in one place to deal Aero DMG to surrounding enemies. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.

source: Un Resonador cuyo forte despertó con un evento que cambió su vida.
target: A Resonator who awakened their Forte through a life-changing event.

source: Un Resonador cuyo forte despertó de forma natural durante su crecimiento.
target: A Resonator who naturally awakened their Forte during their growth.

source: Un Resonador cuyo forte latente despertó de forma prematura a través de una estimulación artificial controlada.
target: A Resonator whose latent Forte was prematurely awakened via controlled artificial stimulation.

source: Un Resonador nacido con un forte natural.
target: A Resonator born with innate Forte.

source: Un Résonateur dont le Forte latent a été éveillé prématurément par stimulation artificielle.
target: A Resonator whose latent Forte was prematurely awakened via controlled artificial stimulation.

source: Un Résonateur dont le Forte s'est éveillé naturellement au cours de sa croissance.
target: A Resonator who naturally awakened their Forte during their growth.

source: Un Résonateur né avec un Forte inné.
target: A Resonator born with innate Forte.

source: Un Résonateur qui a éveillé son Forte à travers un événement qui a changé sa vie.
target: A Resonator who awakened their Forte through a life-changing event.

source: Un ancien poème épique de Rinascita. C'était le premier à mélanger le folklore de diverses régions aux histoires de la Sentinelle et à évoquer les origines du Carnaval.
target: An ancient epic poem of Rinascita. It pioneered blending various regional folkfore with the tales of the Sentinel, including the first accounts of the Carnevale's origins.

source: Un antiguo poema épico de Rinascita. Fue pionero en mezclar diversos folclores regionales con los relatos del Centinela, incluidos los primeros relatos sobre los orígenes del Carnevale.
target: An ancient epic poem of Rinascita. It pioneered blending various regional folkfore with the tales of the Sentinel, including the first accounts of the Carnevale's origins.

source: Un art martial incarnant la sagesse taoïste, où les pratiquants s'harmonisent avec les rythmes de la nature pour développer une force équilibrée du corps et de l'esprit.
target: A martial art embodying Taoist wisdom, where practitioners harmonize with nature's rhythms to develop balanced strength of body and mind.

source: Un art martial unique pratiqué par Yuanwu, connu pour ses frappes lourdes et féroces. Cependant, seuls ceux qui tempèrent leur force avec un contrôle précis peuvent le manier sans se briser eux-mêmes.
target: A unique martial art practiced by Yuanwu, known for its heavy and fierce strikes. However, only those who temper their strength with precise control can wield it without breaking themselves.

source: Un arte marcial que representa a la sabiduría taoísta, donde sus practicantes armonizan con los ritmos de la naturaleza para desarrollar una fuerza equilibrada del cuerpo y la mente.
target: A martial art embodying Taoist wisdom, where practitioners harmonize with nature's rhythms to develop balanced strength of body and mind.

source: Un banco de los Montelli que se encuentra en el corazón de la ciudad de Raguna.
target: A Montelli bank situated at the heart of the Ragunna City.

source: Un bâtiment formidable dédié à la vénération de Statue de la Sentinelle. Situé à la ville de Ragunna, il comprend deux niveaux et on l'appelle généralement « Cathédrale du Mercure ». De plus, il est également le siège de l'Ordre des Profondeurs.
target: A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue.

source: Un campo de experimentación submarino y remoto, construido por los Fractsidus y la Orden, donde ambas sociedades persiguen objetivos secretos bajo la tapadera de un centro de reciclaje y producción de ecos comunes.
target: A secluded underwater experiment facility built by the Fractsidus and the Order, where they both pursue hidden ambitions under the guise of Common Echo reprocessing and production.

source: Un colossal Tacet Discord semblable à une baleine. Malgré sa nature paisible, sa taille gigantesque peut involontairement causer d'importantes destructions.
target: A colossal, whale-like Tacet Discord. Depite its gentle nature, its gargantuan size can inadvertently cause significant destruction.

source: Un conjunto de tácticas centrado en la supresión de fuego mediante el aumento de la velocidad de ataque y los efectos de control.
target: A Tactic Set focused on fire suppression by boosting Attack Speed and Control effects.

source: Un conjunto de tácticas que genera relámpagos en cadena que rebotan entre objetivos, y que se activa al infligir parálisis a los objetivos.
target: A Tactic Set that generates Chain Lightnings bouncing between targets, which is triggered by inflicting Paralysis on the targets.

source: Un conjunto de tácticas que mejora la eficiencia en la obtención de recursos y convierte los recursos excedentes en poder ofensivo.
target: A Tactic Set that improves resource acquisition efficiency and converts surplus resources into offensive power.

source: Un cours d'eau long et étroit situé entre la Septimont continentale et les plateaux de Sanguis.
target: The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.

source: Un cristal qui fige les fréquences, création onirique infusée d'un pouvoir mystérieux.
target: Crystallized fragments of frozen frequencies. These Dream creations possess unique powers.

source: Un deporte competitivo popular en todo el mundo que pone a prueba tanto la fuerza como la resistencia de sus participantes.
target: A globally popular competitive sport that puts both the strength and endurance of its participants to the test.

source: Un dispositivo para incubar Ecos comunes. En su interior, las frecuencias retorcidas y fragmentadas de los Ecos se reconstruyen, formando nuevos Ecos comunes.
target: A device for incubating Common Echoes. Twisted, shattered Echo frequencies are reconstructed into new Common Echoes within its chamber.

source: Un edificio sagrado de dos pisos en la ciudad de Raguna, dedicado a la adoración de la estatua de los centinelas.
target: A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue.

source: Un emblema creado a partir de la propia frecuencia de Hsin, la vulpina lunar. Contiene una parte de la autoridad de la centinela.
target: A token created from Hsin the Moon Fox's own frequency. It contains part of the Sentinel's authority.

source: Un enorme maletín que Roccia siempre tiene a su lado y cuenta con varios elementos de utilería, guiones teatrales y Perri.
target: A massive suitcase that never leaves Roccia's side, housing various stage props, play scripts, and Pero.

source: Un espace inaccessible caché au plus profond de Somnoire, où dorment d'innombrables rêves collectés.
target: A hidden, inaccessible space deep within Somnoire, where countless collected dreams lie buried.

source: Un groupe de mercenaires de la Nouvelle Fédération mené par Calcharo.
target: A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.

source: Un groupe de spectacle itinérant spécialisé dans la danse du lion traditionnelle. Ils acceptent des commandes à la fois du Théâtre de Jinzhou et de clients privés pour subvenir à leurs besoins et couvrir leurs frais de voyage.
target: A traveling performance group specializing in the traditional Liondance. They take commissions from both the Jinzhou Theater and private clients to support themselves and cover their travel expenses.

source: Un grupo ambulante de actuación que se especializa en la tradicional danza del león. Para financiarse y cubrir sus gastos de viaje, reciben comisiones tanto del Teatro de Jinzhou como de clientes privados.
target: A traveling performance group specializing in the traditional Liondance. They take commissions from both the Jinzhou Theater and private clients to support themselves and cover their travel expenses.

source: Un grupo de mercenarios de Nueva Federación liderado por Calcharo.
target: A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.

source: Un guion de teatro otorgado por Phrolova. Cada actor tiene su papel asignado y todas las historias se desenvuelven exactamente como se escribieron, salvo que...
target: A play script given by Phrolova. Every actor has their assigned role, and all stories unfold exactly as written, unless...

source: Un miroir en cuivre unique offert à Nomade par Buling. Dans le folklore de Jinzhou, les miroirs révèlent des vérités cachées. Et celui-ci semble montrer des choses invisibles...
target: In the tales of Huanglong, mirrors are said to reveal hidden truths. And this one appears to show things unseen...

source: Un mundo construido sobre miles de reverberaciones de muerte. Un espacio de frecuencias decadentes donde Phrolova encontró el renacimiento, y que ahora se convierte en parte de su existencia.
target: A world built upon thousands of Reverberations. A domain of decaying frequencies. A place where Phrolova found rebirth, which has now become a part of her existence.

source: Un nom majestueux pour la ville de Septimont, perchée au sommet de la colline Capitoline. Ses habitants sont réputés comme maîtres sculpteurs, chasseurs habiles et gladiateurs impressionnants qui célèbrent l'héroïsme.
target: A majestic name for the city of Septimont, perched atop Capitoline Hill. Its people are renowned as master sculptors, skilled hunters, and awe-inspiring gladiators who celebrate heroism.

source: Un nombre majestuoso para la ciudad de Septimont, situada en lo alto de la Colina Capitolina. Su pueblo es reconocido por sus maestros escultores, hábiles cazadores e impresionantes gladiadores que celebran el heroísmo.
target: A majestic name for the city of Septimont, perched atop Capitoline Hill. Its people are renowned as master sculptors, skilled hunters, and awe-inspiring gladiators who celebrate heroism.

source: Un objet précieux conservé par la Sentinelle qui garde des données d'héritage essentielles sur les Sentinelles et la civilisation.
target: A precious item kept by the Sentinel, containing vital legacy data concerning the Sentinels and civilization.

source:
Un objet utilisé par les Royans pour observer le noyau du réacteur que seuls les Six héliodiques peuvent manipuler.
Lors de la cérémonie du Renouveau solaire, il fournit à Hélios les données brutes d'observation du noyau du réacteur.
target:
An artifact used exclusively by the Heliodic Six to observe the Reactor Drive.
During the New Solar Ceremony, it provides Helios with raw observational data on the Reactor Drive.

source: Un piège sera lancée et il explosera pour infliger des Dégâts Fusion, l'explosion se déclenche lorsqu'il touche un ennemi.
target: Randomly flips a trap that detonates after a while or upon touching an enemy, dealing AoE Fusion DMG.

source: Un popular pub situado en el barrio más común, famoso por su característica bebida “Solis”. Los gladiadores a menudo entrenan allí y el que pierde paga la cuenta.
target: A popular tavern situated in the commoner neighborhood, famous for its signature drink "Solis." Gladiators often spar there, with the loser footing the bill.

source: Un profundo espacio oculto e inaccesible dentro de Somnolencia, donde yacen enterrados innumerables sueños recogidos.
target: A hidden, inaccessible space deep within Somnoire, where countless collected dreams lie buried.

source: Un présage de la prochaine Marée noire, qui perdure à Septimont depuis des années. La région qu'il couvre est connue des habitants sous le nom de « terres de chasse ».
target: An omen of the coming Dark Tide, one that has lingered over Septimont for years. The region it shrouds is known to Septimontians as the "hunting grounds."

source: Un pub populaire situé dans le quartier des roturiers, célèbre pour sa boisson signature « Solis ». Les gladiateurs s'y affrontent souvent, le perdant payant l'addition.
target: A popular tavern situated in the commoner neighborhood, famous for its signature drink "Solis." Gladiators often spar there, with the loser footing the bill.

source: Un pueblo olvidado de gladiadores ubicado en el Yermo, en los niveles inferiores de las Mesetas Sanguis.
target: A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.

source: Un rivage où les poètes et les musiciens rinascitains enterrent leurs instruments hors d'usage.
target: A shore where Rinascitan poets and musicians bury their retired instruments.

source: Un scénario de pièce donné par Phrolova. Chaque acteur a son rôle attitré, et toutes les histoires se déroulent exactement comme elles sont écrites, à moins que...
target: A play script given by Phrolova. Every actor has their assigned role, and all stories unfold exactly as written, unless...

source: Un ser extraño que vive dentro de la Caja Peculiar que posee Roccia. Parece haber nacido a partir de las inspiraciones impregnadas en los objetos recogidos de la caja.
target: A strange being that resides within the Magic Box carried by Roccia. It appears to be born from the inspirations imbued in the collected objects inside the box.

source: Un singular arte marcial practicado por Yuanwu, conocido por sus golpes pesados y feroces. Sin embargo, solo aquellos que moderan su fuerza con preciso control pueden manejarlo sin romperse.
target: A unique martial art practiced by Yuanwu, known for its heavy and fierce strikes. However, only those who temper their strength with precise control can wield it without breaking themselves.

source: Un singular espejo de cobre que es un regalo de Buling para el errante. En el folclore de Jinzhou, los espejos revelan verdades escondidas. Y este parece mostrar cosas nunca antes vistas...
target: In the tales of Huanglong, mirrors are said to reveal hidden truths. And this one appears to show things unseen...

source: Un sport de compétition mondialement populaire qui met à l'épreuve à la fois la force et l'endurance de ses participants.
target: A globally popular competitive sport that puts both the strength and endurance of its participants to the test.

source: Un tipo de daño especial que algunos factores de resonancia pueden potenciar.
target: A special DMG type that can be enhanced by some Resonance Factors.

source: Un tipo especial de matriz estelar que se usa para contener los errores y datos descartados del Sistema Tetis.
target: A type of special Stellar Matrix used to contain the errors and discarded data of Tethys System.

source: Un type d'Exonuée provenant des structures neuronales de l'Exoarpenteur. On dit qu'ils incarneraient les fragments de la conscience de l'Exoarpenteur.
target: A type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.

source: Un type de Matrice stellaire spéciale utilisée pour contenir les erreurs et les données rejetées du système Tethys.
target: A type of special Stellar Matrix used to contain the errors and discarded data of Tethys System.

source: Un type de Tacet Discord né de la Marée noire.
target: A type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.

source: Un type de dégât qui peut être amélioré par certains Facteurs de résonance.
target: A special DMG type that can be enhanced by some Resonance Factors.

source: Un título con el que una existencia misteriosa se refiere a Yangyang. Designa a quien hace una ofrenda a la voz.
target: A title addressed by a mysterious existence to Yangyang. It refers to one who offers to the voice.

source: Un valioso objeto custodiado por el Centinela que contiene datos fundamentales sobre los Centinelas y su civilización.
target: A precious item kept by the Sentinel, containing vital legacy data concerning the Sentinels and civilization.

source: Un Écho commun à la forme d'un grand cor. Le long beuglement aigu du Hornett est utilisé pour signaler le début ou la fin des opérations de chasse à grande échelle.
target: A Common Echo in the form of a large horn. Hornett's high-pitched and lengthy blare is used to signal the beginning or the conclusion of large-scale hunting operations.

source: Un Écho formé à partir des réverbérations d'un héros tombé, fusionné à son armure. Il aspire à revivre la passion des batailles glorieuses.
target: An Echo formed from the Reverberation of a fallen hero, fused into his armor. It longs to relive the thrill of glorious battle.

source: Un être étrange qui réside dans la Boîte magique transportée par Roccia. Il semble être né des inspirations imprégnées dans les objets collectés à l'intérieur de la boîte.
target: A strange being that resides within the Magic Box carried by Roccia. It appears to be born from the inspirations imbued in the collected objects inside the box.

source: Una actividad que se realiza en las profundidades de Somnolencia. Te invitaron a ser juez, pero la identidad del anfitrión sigue siendo un misterio.
target: An activity held in the depths of Somnoire. You've been invited to be a judge, but the identity of the host remains a complete mystery.

source: Una bebida energética aprobada por Lupa.
target: An energy drink endorsed by Lupa.

source: Una cordillera situada en la periferia de Septimont, gravemente afectada por la Marea Oscura y, por ello, poco frecuentada. Algunos gladiadores que buscan superarse acuden aquí a entrenar.
target: A chain of mountains marking Septimont's edge, severely corrupted by the Dark Tide. Only the most daring Gladiators venture here seeking to train in its harsh conditions.

source: Una criatura remanente que se asemeja a una fruta de udumbara blanca. Puede comunicarse con Baizhi por telepatía.
target: A Remnant Creature reminiscent of a white udumbara. It can communicate with Baizhi through telepathy.

source: Una criatura remanente sellada dentro del Farol Vital de Jingran y vinculada a él mediante un pacto especial.
target: A Remnant Creature sealed within Jingran's Life Lamp, bound to him through a special pact.

source: Una de las señales que anuncian la llegada de una marea oscura. Ocurre cuando innumerables Disonancias Tácitas se aglutinan debajo de la nube de plaga, mientras descienden sobre Septimont con olas de destrucción.
target: One of the signs that heralds the coming of a Dark Tide. It's when countless Tacet Discords swarm beneath the Blightcloud, descending upon Septimont in waves of destruction.

source: Una dedicada protectora de la magistrada, que también trabaja como su secretaria personal.
target: A dedicated protector of the Magistrate, also serving as their personal secretary.

source: Una dimensión especial dedicada al misterioso festival de cine en las profundidades de Somnolencia. Aunque está aislado del resto de Somnolencia, cuenta con el mejor equipamiento y entorno para proyectar películas.
target: A special dimension dedicated to the mysterious film festival in the depths of Somnoire. Though isolated from the rest of Somnoire, it boasts the best equipment and environment for movie screenings.

source: Una disonancia tácita colosal, del tamaño de una ballena. Más allá de su naturaleza gentil, su descomunal tamaño puede causar una destrucción significativa sin querer.
target: A colossal, whale-like Tacet Discord. Depite its gentle nature, its gargantuan size can inadvertently cause significant destruction.

source: Una extensión especial que recoge todos los sueños de Solaris desde que existe. La controlan dos porteros.
target: A special expanse that collects all the dreams in Solaris since it came into being. It is managed by two Gatekeepers.

source: Una forma de energía pura con frecuencias completas. La información que carga trasciende al tiempo y al espacio, por lo que permanece en un estado constante y estable.
target: A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.

source: Una frecuencia única de Voluntad de Espada desprendida de Qingxiao, que condensa lo más esencial y puro de su Forte.
target: A unique frequency of Sword Intent split off by Qingxiao, condensing her most essential and purest Resonance Energy.

source: Una gran construcción ubicada en el eje central de Jinzhou. No solo se reserva para recepciones importantes o para discutir asuntos clave, sino que también se establece como el símbolo de esperanza para la gente de Huanglong.
target: A grand construction located in the central axis of Jinzhou. Not only it reserves the functions of important reception and discussion of major issues, but also sets itself as the symbol of hope for the people of Huanglong.

source: Una orilla donde poetas y músicos rinascenses entierran sus instrumentos retirados.
target: A shore where Rinascitan poets and musicians bury their retired instruments.

source: Una región ubicada entre Mengzhou y Jinzhou. Antaño un bastión estratégico para interceptar disonancias tácitas, hoy se considera un paso crucial entre ambas ciudades.
target: A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.

source: Una réplica del Eco, con el mismo atributo y la misma obtención de Cupones diarios. No posee habilidades ni efectos de mejora.
target: A copy of the Echo that shares its Daily Coupon yield and Dream Attribute. It has no skills or buff effects.

source: Una secta del templo de Septimont que puede predecir el futuro. Oyen las melodías del destino con un costo personal, y ofrecen su guía a aquellos que buscan respuestas.
target: Leaders of Septimont's temple who can foretell fate. They listen to the strings of destiny at a personal cost and offer guidance to those who seek answers.

source: Una vía de transmisión de señales. Durante la simulación, la Segunda venida de Solaris se conectó brevemente con el sistema Tetis y creó un canal temporal entre ambos.
target: A signal transmission pathway. During its simulation, the Second Coming of Solaris briefly linked with the Tethys System, creating a temporary channel between them.

source: Una vía fluvial estrecha y alargada, situada entre el continente de Septimont y las Mesetas Sanguis
target: The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.

source: Une activité qui se déroule dans les profondeurs de Somnoire. Vous avez reçu une invitation à y être juge. L'identité de l'hôte reste un mystère complet.
target: An activity held in the depths of Somnoire. You've been invited to be a judge, but the identity of the host remains a complete mystery.

source: Une banque Montelli située au cœur de la ville de Ragunna.
target: A Montelli bank situated at the heart of the Ragunna City.

source: Une boisson énergisante promue par Lupa.
target: An energy drink endorsed by Lupa.

source: Une chaîne de montagnes qui marque la frontière de Septimont gravement corrompue par la Marée noire. Seuls les gladiateurs les plus audacieux s'y aventurent pour s'entraîner dans ses conditions difficiles.
target: A chain of mountains marking Septimont's edge, severely corrupted by the Dark Tide. Only the most daring Gladiators venture here seeking to train in its harsh conditions.

source: Une créature vestigiale ressemblant à un udumbara blanc. Elle peut communiquer avec Baizhi par télépathie.
target: A Remnant Creature reminiscent of a white udumbara. It can communicate with Baizhi through telepathy.

source: Une créature vestigiale, liée à Jingran par un pacte particulier et scellée dans sa Lampe de Vie.
target: A Remnant Creature sealed within Jingran's Life Lamp, bound to him through a special pact.

source: Une dimension spéciale dédiée au mystérieux festival de cinéma dans les profondeurs de Somnoire. Bien qu'isolée du reste de Somnoire, elle dispose du meilleur équipement et environnement pour les projections de films.
target: A special dimension dedicated to the mysterious film festival in the depths of Somnoire. Though isolated from the rest of Somnoire, it boasts the best equipment and environment for movie screenings.

source: Une erreur est survenue. Veuillez contacter le service client
target: The seemingly ordinary attribute ability doesn't seem to need too much description.

source: Une fille obtient toujours ce qu'elle veut !
target: A Girl Gets What She Wants!

source: Une forme d'énergie pure aux fréquences complètes. Les informations qu'elle véhicule transcendent le temps et l'espace, persistant dans un état stable et immuable.
target: A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.

source: Une fréquence unique, expression de la détermination du sabre. Détachée par Qingxiao, elle concentre l'essence la plus pure de son énergie résonatrice.
target: A unique frequency of Sword Intent split off by Qingxiao, condensing her most essential and purest Resonance Energy.

source: Une médaille décernée aux gladiateurs par les dirigeants de Septimont pour les récompenser de leur service dans la chasse contre la Marée noire. Considérée comme l'une des plus grandes décorations chez les gladiateurs.
target: A medal bestowed by the rulers of Septimont exclusively to Gladiators who demonstrate exceptional performance in the hunt against the Dark Tide. It is regarded as one of the highest honors among Gladiators.

source: Une protectrice dévouée de la Magistrate, servant également comme son secrétaire personnel.
target: A dedicated protector of the Magistrate, also serving as their personal secretary.

source: Une région située entre Mengzhou et Jinzhou. Elle constitue un carrefour vital entre les deux villes, ainsi qu'un point stratégique pour intercepter les Tacets Discords.
target: A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.

source: Une secte du temple de Septimont peut prédire le destin. Elle écoute les fils du destin à un coût personnel et offre des conseils à ceux qui cherchent des réponses.
target: Leaders of Septimont's temple who can foretell fate. They listen to the strings of destiny at a personal cost and offer guidance to those who seek answers.

source: Une tactique offensive qui déclenche des attaques puissantes tout en augmentant la vitesse d'attaque et l'efficacité des effets de contrôle.
target: A Tactic Set focused on fire suppression by boosting Attack Speed and Control effects.

source: Une tactique qui améliore l'efficacité d'obtenir les ressources et de les transformer en puissance offensive.
target: A Tactic Set that improves resource acquisition efficiency and converts surplus resources into offensive power.

source: Une valise énorme qui ne quitte jamais le côté de Roccia, contenant divers accessoires de scène, des scripts de pièces et Pero.
target: A massive suitcase that never leaves Roccia's side, housing various stage props, play scripts, and Pero.

source: Une ville gladiatrice perdue située dans les Terres déchues aux niveaux inférieurs des plateaux de Sanguis.
target: A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.

source: Une voie de transmission de signaux. Pendant sa simulation, le Sol-2 s'est brièvement connecté au Système Tethys, créant un canal temporaire entre eux.
target: A signal transmission pathway. During its simulation, the Second Coming of Solaris briefly linked with the Tethys System, creating a temporary channel between them.

source: Une étendue spéciale qui recueille tous les rêves de Solaris depuis sa création. Elle est gérée par deux gardiens.
target: A special expanse that collects all the dreams in Solaris since it came into being. It is managed by two Gatekeepers.

source: Une étoile sera lancée de manière aléatoire et elle tombe sur les ennemis pour infliger des Dégâts Fusion.
target: Randomly launches a star to fall upon enemies, dealing Fusion DMG.

source: Uno de los administradores de Somnolencia, encargado de eliminar datos inútiles del reino, o al menos eso dice. Sin embargo, tiene sus propias opiniones sobre lo que clasifica como “inútil”.
target: One of the administrators of Somnoire, tasked with deleting "useless data" within the realm, or so he says. However, he has his own opinions on what qualifies as "useless."

source: Uno de los administradores de Somnolencia, encargado de mantener al reino en buen funcionamiento, o al menos eso dice.
target: One of the administrators of Somnoire, tasked with keeping the realm running smoothly, or so he says.

source: Uno de los presagios de la llegada de la Marea Oscura, que no ha desaparecido durante años. La zona que cubre es llamada por los septimontinos «los terrenos de caza».
target: An omen of the coming Dark Tide, one that has lingered over Septimont for years. The region it shrouds is known to Septimontians as the "hunting grounds."

source: Usar Predição: Visão Interior faz com que Hiyuki entre em Eu Profetizado. Enquanto estiver em Eu Profetizado, Hiyuki desbloqueia novos movimentos e restaura Coração Gélido através de certos ataques.
target: Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision causes Hiyuki to enter Foreclaimed Self. While in Foreclaimed Self, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores Frostheart through certain attacks.

source: セブン・ヒルズの権力者。歴代の総督は皆、絶対的な力を有し、強者のみがセブン・ヒルズをリードする資格を持つ。

source: セブン・ヒルズの看板競技スポーツ。グラディエーターたちは音骸と互いに協力し、試合の勝利を掴み取る。
target: Septimont's signature sport, where Echoes battle beside Gladiators. Victory in the arena hinges on their cooperation.

source: セブン・ヒルズの真殿にて運命をうかがい、預言を行う集団。彼女たちは代価を支払うことで、運命から答えを得る。
target: Leaders of Septimont's temple who can foretell fate. They listen to the strings of destiny at a personal cost and offer guidance to those who seek answers.

source: セブン・ヒルズの統治者から授与される勲章で、黒潮での狩猟において顕著な功績を挙げた者のみに与えられる。極めて希少かつ貴重なものであり、グラディエーターにとっては最高位の栄誉の一つとされている。
target: A medal bestowed by the rulers of Septimont exclusively to Gladiators who demonstrate exceptional performance in the hunt against the Dark Tide. It is regarded as one of the highest honors among Gladiators.

source: セブン・ヒルズの議事機関。総督に意見を提供し、総督に代わって行政権の一部を行使するほか、公職の任免においても一定の影響力を持つ。
target: The governing body of Septimont, tasked with advising the Ephor and wielding authority in key administrative matters. It also exercises power over the appointment and dismissal of public officials.

source: セブン・ヒルズの辺境に位置する山脈。潮の侵蝕が比較的深刻なため、訪れる者は稀である。一部の挑戦的なグラディエーターだけが、修行のためここを目指す。

target:
An artifact used exclusively by the Heliodic Six to observe the Reactor Drive.
During the New Solar Ceremony, it provides Helios with raw observational data on the Reactor Drive.

source: ロココが肌身離さず持っている巨大なスーツケース。中には様々な舞台道具や劇の原稿が入っており、同時にペロの住処でもある。

target: KU-Money's Shop appears after certain waves, where you can consume Sim Credits to purchase Tactics and items.

source: 次のウェーブの敵が出現時、氷のまゆがいくつか召喚される。氷のまゆはその周囲にいる全てのキャラに、持続的に【結霜効果】を付与する。

source: 歲主所持有的珍貴之物，存有關於歲主與文明的重要底層數據。

source: 残像の一種であり、黒潮から誕生した生命体に似た存在。

source: 残星組織と教団が共同で建てた、陸地から完全に隔絶された海底にある実験場。公共音骸の大量生産と回収の裏で、双方はそれぞれの思惑を秘めている。
target: A secluded underwater experiment facility built by the Fractsidus and the Order, where they both pursue hidden ambitions under the guise of Common Echo reprocessing and production.

source: 殘星會與修會合作建立的一座與陸地完全隔絕的海底試驗場。在不斷製造、回收大量公共聲骸的背後，雙方都在這裡有著更隱秘的目標。
target: A secluded underwater experiment facility built by the Fractsidus and the Order, where they both pursue hidden ambitions under the guise of Common Echo reprocessing and production.

source: 비야토르 숲에 광범위하게 분포하고 있다. 거대한 태양의 나무가 공중 숲을 이루고, 그 뿌리는 라하이 로이 전역으로 뻗어나가 헬리오자일로 정보를 전송한다
target: Towering constructs widespread in Bjartr Woods, forming a vast, floating forest. Their roots permeate Lahai-Roi, relaying information directly to the Heliogyre.

source: 비첨은 체력과 지구력이 요구되는 스포츠 경기이다. 전 세계적으로 널리 유행하고 있다
target: A globally popular competitive sport that puts both the strength and endurance of its participants to the test.

source: 빛나는 날개의 합주 · 강림, 빛나는 날개의 합주 · 등장을 포함한다
target: Includes Seraphic Duet: Overture and Seraphic Duet: Encore.

source: 사냥단 통칭 「유령사냥단」은 카카루가 신 연방에서 이끄는 용병단이다
target: A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.

source: 사람들의 악몽이나 부정적인 감정의 주파수에서 태어난 잔상으로, 주로 마음의 영역에서 출현한다
target: The Tacet Discords emerge from the frequencies of nightmares and negative emotions. They can often be found in Somnoire.

source: 사랑과 용기를 상징하는 별 모양의 꽃. 이 땅에서 자라나는 별들이 언젠가 들판을 가득 메울 것이다
target: This star-like flower represents love and courage. One day, these earthly stars will blanket every field.

source: 사방으로 함정을 던진 후 일정 시간이 지나면 폭발하여 범위 내에 용융 피해를 입히고, 적군과 접촉 시 바로 폭발한다
target: Randomly flips a trap that detonates after a while or upon touching an enemy, dealing AoE Fusion DMG.

source: 사자춤 공연을 전문으로 하는 퍼레이드 극단으로, 금주 극장이나 민간의 초청을 받아 공연하고, 그 공연 수익은 여비로 사용한다
target: A traveling performance group specializing in the traditional Liondance. They take commissions from both the Jinzhou Theater and private clients to support themselves and cover their travel expenses.

source: 상귀스 사냥 평원의 아래층 침식지에 위치한 몰락한 검투사 마을이다
target: A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.

source: 상귀스 사냥 평원의 아래층에서 흑조(黑潮)에 침식된 구역을 총칭한다. 해당 구역은 극히 위험하며 인기척이 거의 없다
target: The term referring to the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus corrupted by the Dark Tide. This desolate region is marked by hostile conditions and is largely devoid of human activity.

source: 상귀스 사냥 평원의 중상층 구역에 위치하며 일곱 언덕 사람들이 대대로 흑조(黑潮) 및 그의 창조물을 사냥하는 주요 사냥터이다
target: The main hunting ground on the mid to upper levels of the Sanguis Plateaus, where generations of Septimontians battled the Dark Tide and its creations.

source: 생성 횟수가 8회로 증가되고, 폭격 생성 간격이 10초로 연장된다
target: Bombardment becomes 8 times each round, but the interval is extended to 10s.

source: 생성 횟수가 8회로 증가되고, 폭격 생성 간격이 12초로 연장된다
target: Bombardment becomes 8 times each round, but the interval is extended to 12s.

source: 샤콘 혹은 합주의 그림자가 음률의 독주 상태에 진입 시, 자신을 중심으로 근처 파티 내 모든 캐릭터의 기류 피해 보너스를 24% 증가시키고 해당 효과는 중첩이 불가하다
target: When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

source: 솔라리스의 수호신이 가지고 있는 귀중한 물건. 수호신과 문명에 관한 중요한 기초 데이터를 담고 있다
target: A precious item kept by the Sentinel, containing vital legacy data concerning the Sentinels and civilization.

source: 수많은 죽음의 잔향이 구성한 세계로 쇠퇴한 주파수의 영역 공간은 플로로가 새 생명을 얻는 데 도움을 주었고, 이는 그녀 삶의 일부가 되었다
target: A world built upon thousands of Reverberations. A domain of decaying frequencies. A place where Phrolova found rebirth, which has now become a part of her existence.

source: 순수하고 완전한 주파수 에너지 형태로, 울림이 기록된 정보는 시공간을 초월해도 안정적으로 존재한다
target: A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.

source: 스피드 등반 시 스태미나 소모량 x/프레임
심월 여우가 자신의 주파수로 제작하여, 수호신의 권능 일부를 봉인한 신물이다
target: A token created from Hsin the Moon Fox's own frequency. It contains part of the Sentinel's authority.

source: 알토가 「안개」 또는 「허공의 문」을 통과할 때 안개의 잠복 상태에 들어간다
target: When Aalto passes through Mist or Gate of Quandary, he enters the Mistcloak Dash.

source: 야귀군은 행정부대, 선봉부대, 후방부대로 구성되어 있다. 이 모든 부대는 금주 야귀 장군 기염의 지휘 아래 움직인다
target: The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations), all under the command of General Jiyan.

source: 양양은 어릴 적 공명 어빌리티를 각성한 후, 소리와 감정을 포함한 다양한 정보를 담고 있는 특수한 기류를 감지하고 해독할 수 있다
target: Since Yangyang Awakened her Forte at a young age, she became capable of sensing and interpreting a unique form of "streams," which carry various kinds of information, including voices and emotions.

source: 어떠한 신비한 존재가 양양을 부르는 호칭으로, 「소리를 수호하는 자」라는 뜻이다
target: A title addressed by a mysterious existence to Yangyang. It refers to one who offers to the voice.

source: 에코 검투 경기의 참가자. 용감하고 싸움을 잘하며 승리와 영광을 갈망한다
target: Participants in Gladiator matches. They are renowned for their strength and battle prowess and driven by an unyielding thirst for victory and glory.

source: 에코 변화 시, 5% 확률로 「일일 놀이공원 티켓」 획득량이 100% 증가한다
target: When an Echo undergoes Gradation, there is a 5% chance to increase its Daily Coupon yield by 100%.

source: 에코가 꿈 블록에 있을 시, 「일일 놀이공원 티켓」 획득량이 임시로 2 증가되고, 떠난 후 복구된다
target: The Daily Coupon yield of Echoes on these Dream Blocks temporarily increases by 2. The bonus is removed once it leaves these Dream Blocks.

source: 에코가 매일 놀이공원에서 수집 가능한 놀이공원 티켓의 수량이다
target: Daily Coupon yield refers to the base quantity of Dreamland Coupons Echoes can collect per day.

source: 에코가 수집한 티켓. 경영 목표를 달성하고 꿈 속의 놀이공원의 안정성을 유지하는 데 사용된다
target: Coupons collected by Echoes to meet revenue targets and keep the Dreamland stable.

source: 에코가 자신을 제거 혹은 새로운 에코로 융합 시, 추가로 「일일 놀이공원 티켓」 획득량과 동일한 수량의 놀이공원 티켓을 획득한다
target: When an Echo Removes itself or is Integrated into a new Echo, gain additional Dreamland Coupons equal to its own Daily Coupon yield.

source: 에코의 「 일일 놀이공원 티켓」경로를 제외한 다른 경로로 획득한 놀이공원 티켓 수량이 10% 증가된다
target: Dreamland Coupon gained through sources other than Echo Daily Coupon yield is increased by 10%.

source: 엑소스웜의 신체에서 획득한 부품이다. 본질적으로는 여전히 엑소스트라이더의 일부이며, 라하이 로이의 각종 창조물에 광범위하게 사용된다
target: Materials harvested from Exoswarm. Though still essentially parts of the Exostrider, they are widely utilized in engineering Lahai-Roi's various constructs.

source:
엑소스트라이더가 떨어진 후, 대지에 흩어진 엑소스트라이더 세포 잔해가 집합 및 재조합을 통해 형성된 생체 기계 의태 동물이다.
이들은 가축 떼와 라하이 로이의 생물들을 모방하여, 라하이 로이의 생태계를 재건했다
target: Biomechanical creatures formed from the Exostrider's cellular remnants. By mimicking herds and other lifeforms, they helped rebuild Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.

source: 연무의 독창 권법. 용맹하고 포악한 권법이다. 하지만 장시간 선보이기 위해선 스스로 균형을 잘 잡아야 한다
target: A unique martial art practiced by Yuanwu, known for its heavy and fierce strikes. However, only those who temper their strength with precise control can wield it without breaking themselves.

source: 영광의 사자——아르시노사. 영웅들이 교전하고 싸울 때의 분노와 웃음이 그리핀의 조각상과 결합하여 형성된 강력한 에코로 탄생과 함께 일곱 언덕의 중심 도시를 지켜왔다
target: The Lioness of Glory, Arsinosa. Born of battle cries and laughter, fused into the stone form of a mighty half-human, half-lion Echo. Since her genesis, she has stood watch over the City of Septimont.

source: 영웅들의 잔향과 갑옷이 결합하여 만들어진 에코는 영광과 전투를 재현하기를 갈망한다
target: An Echo formed from the Reverberation of a fallen hero, fused into his armor. It longs to relive the thrill of glorious battle.

source: 영윤은 황룡의 지방 행정 수반으로 주(州) 내의 사무를 총괄한다
target: The Magistrate is a governing official who oversees one of the major regions within Huanglong.

source: 영윤을 가까이서 보호하는 호위로, 동시에 비서 직무도 일부 수행한다
target: A dedicated protector of the Magistrate, also serving as their personal secretary.

source: 오래전부터 솔라리스의 모든 꿈을 수집해 온 특수 공간으로, 두 명의 게이트 수호자가 이를 관리한다
target: A special expanse that collects all the dreams in Solaris since it came into being. It is managed by two Gatekeepers.

source: 오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
target: The seemingly ordinary attribute ability doesn't seem to need too much description.

source: 오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
target: the ability to align electric charges.

source: 오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
target: the ability to cool and freeze.

source: 오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
target: the ability to warm and ignite.

source: 외형이 고래와 닮은 거대한 잔상. 온화한 성격이지만 거대한 몸집은 강한 파괴력을 가지고 있다
target: A colossal, whale-like Tacet Discord. Depite its gentle nature, its gargantuan size can inadvertently cause significant destruction.

source: 원하는 놀이공원 에코를 선택하여 필드에 등장시킨다
target: Choose your preferred Echoes and place them on the field.

source: 유령 인형 시리즈 에코 리스트: 유령 인형, 유령 인형 · 헤드, 유령 인형 · 레프, 유령 인형 · 라잇, 이상 · 유령 인형
target: Chop Chop Echoes include: Chop Chop, Chop Chop: Head, Chop Chop: Leftless, Chop Chop: Rightless, Dreamborne: Chop Chop.

source: 육각형 구역과 인접한 다른 육각형 구역은 서로 인접 관계로 간주된다
target: Hexagonal areas that share a border are considered adjacent to each other.

target: Integration: When 3 Echoes with the same Dream Attribute and rarity as this Echo are in the same row, they Ingrate into 1 Stonewall Bracer and gain Dreamland Coupons equal to 30 + total Daily Coupon yield x1.

target: Echoes with this Dream Attribute can grow stronger through Gradation. When certain Echoes meet their Gradation conditions, their Daily Coupon yield increases.

target: Nameless Explorer is greatly empowered, and their ATK is greatly increased.

source: 이름없는 탐색자의 일부 스킬이 지면에 열상 효과를 남긴다. 캐릭터가 명중될 시, 0.5초마다 HP 최대치의 2%에 해당하는 HP가 감소되고, 5초간 지속된다
target: Nameless Explorer's certain skills leave cracks on the ground. Resonators lose 2% of Max HP every 0.5s for 5s when caught in the cracks.

source: 이름없는 탐색자의 일부 스킬이 지면에 열상 효과를 남긴다. 캐릭터가 해당 효과에 명중될 시, 방어력이 15% 감소된다
target: Nameless Explorer's certain skills leave cracks on the ground. Resonators have their DEF lowered by 15% when caught in the cracks.

source: 이성(異性) 무장 · 가고일의 모든 능력이 대폭 강화된다
target: Sentry Construct: Gargoyle is greatly empowered.

source: 이성(異性) 미사일, 타오르는 별 같은 뚜렷한 탄도 효과를 가진 무기이다
target: Weapons that fire ballistic impact projectiles, such as Isomer Bolt and Blazing Star.

source: 이코르 배열은 {0}초 후에 자동으로 폭발하며, 회절 피해를 입히고, 해당 피해는 일반 공격 피해로 적용된다
target: Ichor Deposit detonates automatically after {0}s, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

source: 인위적인 유도와 자극으로 잠재된 공명 어빌리티를 조기 각성한 공명자
target: A Resonator whose latent Forte was prematurely awakened via controlled artificial stimulation.

source: 일곱 언덕 가장자리에 위치한 산맥은 흑조의 침식의 영향을 심하게 받기 때문에 이곳을 찾는 사람이 거의 없다. 도전에 열광하는 검투사들이 수련을 하러 온다
target: A chain of mountains marking Septimont's edge, severely corrupted by the Dark Tide. Only the most daring Gladiators venture here seeking to train in its harsh conditions.

source: 일곱 언덕 근교에 위치하며 검투사들이 협곡을 횡단해 상귀스 사냥 평원을 왕복하기 위한 「하늘을 나는 거점」이다
target: Located on the outskirts of the city of Septimont, it's the "air terminal" where Gladiators cross the canyons and make their trip to and from the Sanguis Plateaus.

source: 일곱 언덕 도시가 타 지역을 연결하는 항구에서는 평소 상선과 어선이 자주 왕래한다. 많은 외부의 검투자와 여행객들도 이곳을 통해 일곱 언덕에 상륙한다
target: The port that connects Septimont to the outside world. Vessels laden with goods and fresh catch arrive by the hour, while visiting Gladiators and travelers make landfall here upon reaching Septimont.

source: 일곱 언덕 민간 생활 구역에 위치한 번화한 주점은 독특한 「솔리스」 술로 유명하다. 정원에서 기술을 겨루는 검투사들이 있는데, 패자가 승자의 비용을 지불해야 한다
target: A popular tavern situated in the commoner neighborhood, famous for its signature drink "Solis." Gladiators often spar there, with the loser footing the bill.

source: 일곱 언덕 본섬과 상귀스 사냥 평원 사이에 있는 길고 좁은 해역
target: The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.

source: 일곱 언덕 성전에는 운명을 들여다보고 예언을 하는 집단이 있다. 그들은 대가를 지불하여 운명을 듣고 답을 내린다
target: Leaders of Septimont's temple who can foretell fate. They listen to the strings of destiny at a personal cost and offer guidance to those who seek answers.

source: 일곱 언덕 예언자들의 거처이자 운명을 엿보고 예언을 기록하는 장소이기도 하다. 종종 「성전」으로 불리기도 한다
target: The living quarters of Priestesses, where fate is observed and prophecies are documented. Commonly referred to as the "Temple."

source: 일곱 언덕 통치자가 수여하는 훈장으로, 흑조 사냥에서 탁월한 공적을 세운 사람에게만 주어진다. 극히 희귀하고 귀중하며, 검투사에게 있어서 최고의 영예 중 하나로 여겨진다
target: A medal bestowed by the rulers of Septimont exclusively to Gladiators who demonstrate exceptional performance in the hunt against the Dark Tide. It is regarded as one of the highest honors among Gladiators.

source: 일곱 언덕 현직 최고 예언자이자 예언자의 수장이다
target: The current Head Priestess of Septimont.

source: 일곱 언덕에서 규모가 가장 크고 영향력 있는 에코 검투 대회는 일곱 언덕의 수입원이자 경제적 기둥 중 하나이다
target: The largest and most influential Gladiator event in Septimont, as well as a key economic pillar of the city.

source: 일곱 언덕은 카피톨리누스 언덕 위에 위치해 있으며, 「그리핀의 요새」라는 명성을 가지고 있다. 일곱 언덕 사람들은 조각을 사랑하고 사냥을 좋아하며 검투에 능하고 영웅을 존경한다
target: A majestic name for the city of Septimont, perched atop Capitoline Hill. Its people are renowned as master sculptors, skilled hunters, and awe-inspiring gladiators who celebrate heroism.

source: 일곱 언덕의 권력자. 역대 장관들은 절대적인 힘을 가지고 있으며, 강한 자만이 일곱 언덕을 이끌 자격이 있다
target: The ruler of Septimont. Ephors wield absolute power, as only the strong are deemed worthy to lead.

source: 일곱 언덕의 대표적인 경기 방식. 검투사들은 에코와 협력하여 경기의 승리를 거둔다
target: Septimont's signature sport, where Echoes battle beside Gladiators. Victory in the arena hinges on their cooperation.

source: 일곱 언덕의 의정 기구는 장관에게 조언을 제공하고 장관을 대신하여 일부 행정권을 행사하는 것 외에도 공직 임명과 해임에서도 일정한 영향력을 가지고 있다
target: The governing body of Septimont, tasked with advising the Ephor and wielding authority in key administrative matters. It also exercises power over the appointment and dismissal of public officials.

source: 일곱 언덕의 중심 도시——그리핀의 요새가 위치한 곳. 또한 최고의 검투 대회가 열리는 장소이기도 하다
target: Septimont's central city—home to Gryphon's Fortress and the stage of the Great Agon.

source: 일반 공격 4단 발동 후, 해독 상태에 진입하고 {0}초간 지속된다. 다른 캐릭터로 전환하면 해당 효과는 즉시 종료된다
target: Enter the Decipher state after casting Basic Attack Stage 4 for {0}s. This effect ends early when Sigrika is switched off the field.

source: 일부 몬스터는 12초마다 캐릭터를 자신의 주변으로 끌어당긴다
target: Some enemies will pull Resonators towards them every 12s.

source: 일부 몬스터는 20초마다 캐릭터를 자신의 주변으로 끌어당긴다
target: Some enemies will pull Resonators towards them every 20s.

source: 일부 몬스터의 HP가 HP 최대치의 50% 이하일 경우, 몬스터를 소환하여 전투를 지원한다
target: Some enemies will summon reinforcements when their HP drops below 50%.

target: Certain enemies are buffed: All other enemies nearby have their ATK increased by 20%.

target: Certain enemies are buffed: All other enemies nearby have their DEF increased by 20%.

source: 일부 적군이 획득하는 효과: 캐릭터의 공격력을 20% 감소시킨다. 일부 적군이 획득하는 효과: 캐릭터의 방어력을 20% 감소시킨다

Certain enemies are buffed: Reduce the Resonator's ATK by 20%.

target: Certain Resonators can inflict Hack - Shifting on the target. During this state, if the affected target is hit by Tune Break, their Hack - Shifting state is replaced with Hack - Interfered.

source: 일정 라운드마다 등장하며, 가상 클램 코인을 소모하여 전술과 아이템을 구매할 수 있다
target: KU-Money's Shop appears after certain waves, where you can consume Sim Credits to purchase Tactics and items.

source: 일정 조건을 충족하면 아이템의 희귀 레벨이 자동으로 상승되며, 효과도 함께 강화된다. 아이템의 초기 희귀 레벨은 1이다
target: Relic items will automatically level up and grow more powerful after meeting certain conditions. Relic Level starts at 1 by default.

source: 일종의 엑소스웜으로, 엑소스트라이더의 신경 세포 부분에서 유래한 기계이며, 엑소스트라이더 의식의 일부분을 담고 있다고 알려져 있다
target: A type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.

source: 일종의 잔상으로 흑조(黑潮)에서 탄생한 유사 생명체
target: A type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.

source: 자신이 피해를 받기 직전에, 자신이 짧은 시간 내에 받는 피해를 감소시킨다
target: Briefly reduces DMG taken right before receiving an instance of DMG.

source: 자원 획득 효율을 강화하고 남은 자원을 피해 능력으로 전환할 수 있는 전술 유형이다
target: A Tactic Set that improves resource acquisition efficiency and converts surplus resources into offensive power.

source: 잔성회와 수도회가 협력하여 설립한 육지와 완전히 단절된 바다 속 실험장. 대량의 공공 에코를 끊임없이 제작하고 회수하는 이면에는, 양측 모두의 보다 은밀한 목표가 존재한다
target: A secluded underwater experiment facility built by the Fractsidus and the Order, where they both pursue hidden ambitions under the guise of Common Echo reprocessing and production.

source: 장리의 사부이자 황룡에서 유명한 은둔 대가. 책략에 능통하고, 세계 각지를 돌며, 도를 전파한다
target: Changli's mentor, a revered hermit in Huanglong known for his knowledge of statecraft and diplomacy. He traveled widely to share his wisdom and knowledge.

source: 적군 격파 시, 특수 효과를 발생할 수 있다
target: Triggers a special effect when defeating an enemy.

source: 적군의 공격력이 40% 증가된다. 캐릭터가 조화도 파괴를 입힌 후, 2초 동안 모든 피해를 면역한다
target: Enemy ATK is increased by 40%. Dealing Tune Break DMG grants the Resonator immunity to all damage for 2s.

source: 적군의 공진 수치 최대치가 100% 증가되고, 캐릭터의 협동 공격이 명중할 때마다 적군의 공진 수치가 추가로 7% 감소된다
target: Enemies' Max Vibration Strength is increased by 100%. Each time hitting an enemy with Coordinated Attack additionally reduces their Vibration Strength by 7%.

source: 적군의 공진 수치 최대치가 100% 증가되고, 캐릭터의 회피 반격이 명중할 때마다 적군의 공진 수치가 추가로 10% 감소된다

Enemy Max Vibration Strength is increased by 100%.
Enemy Max Vibration Strength is increased by 15%.

Enemy All-Attribute RES is increased by 10%.

source: 전설 속 왕의 자질을 가진 일곱 언덕의 지도자. 오래된 예언에 등장하는 말로, 라군나 사람들이 남긴 예언과 연결된다. 오직 영웅의 왕좌에 오른 사람만이 일곱 언덕을 재난에서 구해낼 수 있다
target: The legendary ruler of Septimont. The legend traces its roots to an ancient prophecy that only the one who becomes the Hero of Heroes can save Septimont from falling into ruin.

source: 제거에 포함된 조작: 교환, 융합, 포식 당함과 자신 제거 (에코 해고는 제거에 포함되지 않는다)
target: Echoes are seen as Removed when they are Exchanged, Integrated, Devoured, or Removed by themselves. Dismissing an Echo does not count as Removal.

source: 제자리에 머물며 주변의 적군을 공격하고 기류 피해를 입히지만, 공격 속도 증가 효과는 받지 못한다
target: A summoned Feilian Beringal that stays in one place to deal Aero DMG to surrounding enemies. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.

젠니가 아래 2가지 상태에 있을 경우, 공명 스킬을 길게 누르면 준비 태세에 진입할 수 있다.

target: Crystallized fragments of frozen frequencies. These Dream creations possess unique powers.

source: 줌 1스택 당 파티 내 등장 캐릭터가 입히는 에코 어빌리티 피해의 크리티컬 피해를 {9} 증가시킨다
target: Each stack of Zoom increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by {9}.

target: Continuously sprays fire forward, dealing Havoc DMG. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.

진기한 상자 안에 있는 신비한 생물, 상자 속에 남겨진 물품에 깃든 영감이 응집되어 형성된 존재로 추정된다
target: A strange being that resides within the Magic Box carried by Roccia. It appears to be born from the inspirations imbued in the collected objects inside the box.

source: 질서 없는 어둠의 불꽃, 폭발의 징조 같은 특수 효과를 발생시키는 무기이다
target: Weapons with special effects, such as Rampant Fire and Explosive Omen.

source: 찬란한 빛의 증폭 상태일 경우, 공명 해방 경계를 부순 별빛 · 과부하 발동 시, 추가로 「공명률」을 획득할 수 있다
target: When in Starlume Acceleration, casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive additionally recovers Resonance Rate.

source: 채널은 신호 전송의 통로이다. 세컨드 솔라리스 생성 중 테티스와 짧은 연결을 진행한 적이 있어 둘 사이에는 채널이 존재한다
target: A signal transmission pathway. During its simulation, the Second Coming of Solaris briefly linked with the Tethys System, creating a temporary channel between them.

source: 협주 이펙트가 발생할 때, 두 캐릭터의 속성 유형이 모두 인멸일 경우, 인멸 제주가 발생되어 목표에게 인멸 피해를 입힌다
target: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of Havoc, it triggers Havoc Flurry, which deals Havoc damage.

source: 협주 이펙트가 발생할 때, 두 캐릭터의 속성 유형이 모두 전도일 경우, 전도 제주가 발생되어 목표에게 전도 피해를 입힌다
target: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of Electro, it triggers the Electro flurry, which deals Electro damage.

source: 호나미 시가 속한 나라. 비록 비명 이상 현상이 자주 발생하지만, 여전히 번영한 도시 문명을 이어 나가고 있으며, 내부에는 발달한 대중교통망이 건설되어 있다
target: The nation encompassing Honami City. Despite the frequent Waveworn Phenomena, it maintains a prosperous, highly urbanized society, marked by its sprawling railroad network.

source:
화살곰 획득 효과: 폭주의 고릴라가 받는 피해가 50% 감소된다.
몬스터 처치 시, 파티 내 캐릭터의 방어력이 10% 증가하고, 해당 효과는 중첩이 가능하다
target:
Spearback provides the following effect: Feilian Beringal takes 50% less DMG.
Defeating an enemy increases DEF of Resonators in the team by 10%. This effect is stackable.

source: 활강 시 스태미나 소모 속도 x/초
활강 시 스태미나 소모 속도 x/초
황룡의 과학 연구를 담당하는 정부 기관, 주마다 지부를 두고 있다
target: The state-run research institute of Huanglong, with branch organizations established in each city.

source: 황룡의 사법 기관 중 하나로, 지방 법률을 집행하는 기관이다. 하위 기관으로는 지방의 민사 및 치안 사무를 담당하는 순찰소가 있으며, 이곳에서 일하는 사람을 「순찰관」이라 부른다
target: The local law enforcement arm of the Justice Commission. Operating through Patrol Stations, it maintains civil order and handles public security matters. Its officers are known as "Patrollers."

source: 황룡의 수도로 정치, 경제, 문화의 중심지이다
target: The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.

source: 황룡의 전설에서 거울은 진실을 비추는 물건이다. 그것으로 보이지 않는 무언가를 볼 수 있을 것 같다...
target: In the tales of Huanglong, mirrors are said to reveal hidden truths. And this one appears to show things unseen...

source: 효과 지속 기간 내에 어떠한 조작도 불가하며, 2초간 지속된다
target: Targets in this state cannot perform any actions within the duration. The effect lasts for 2s.

source: 효과가 지속되는 동안 어떤 행동도 취할 수 없으며, 해당 효과는 1.5초간 지속된다
target: Targets with Dispersion are immobilized for 1.5s.

source: 후현 삼기의 구성원은 후현 기사라고도 불린다
target: The members of Xuan Triad are also known as Xuan Watchers.

source: 흑조가 도래할 전조 중의 하나. 수많은 잔상이 흑조 구름 아래 나타나 일곱 언덕을 습격한다
target: One of the signs that heralds the coming of a Dark Tide. It's when countless Tacet Discords swarm beneath the Blightcloud, descending upon Septimont in waves of destruction.

source: 흑조가 도래할 전조 중의 하나로 몇 년 동안 줄곧 사라지지 않았다. 그것이 뒤덮은 곳을 일곱 언덕 사람들은 「사냥터」라고 부른다
target: An omen of the coming Dark Tide, one that has lingered over Septimont for years. The region it shrouds is known to Septimontians as the "hunting grounds."

source: 흑조에 의해 부식된 사물에 나타나는 흔적은 부식된 물체에 따라 퇴색, 석회화 또는 산호화되는 모습을 보인다
target: Scars of the Dark Tide's touch. It may appear as discoloration, calcification, or even coral-like growths, depending on what has been corrupted.

source: 히유키가 끌어온 내 가능성 · 독심 발동 시 선견력에 진입한다. 선견력 기간 동안 새로운 전투 형태를 해제하고, 특정 스킬을 통해 「한기」를 회복할 수 있다
target: Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision causes Hiyuki to enter Foreclaimed Self. While in Foreclaimed Self, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores Frostheart through certain attacks.
